name: MultAdd.multAdd_def
statement: multAdd a b = a + b + a * b
proof: rfl

name: MultAdd.multAdd_lift
doc: The lift: mult-add is multiplication seen through x ↦ 1 + x.
proof:
by
  unfold multAdd; grind

name: MultAdd.multAdd_lift'
doc: The lift with the 1 on the right (handy on Nat, where we add 1 to both sides).
proof:
by
  unfold multAdd; grind

name: MultAdd.multAdd_comm
statement: multAdd a b = multAdd b a
proof:
by
  unfold multAdd; grind

name: MultAdd.multAdd_assoc
statement: multAdd (multAdd a b) c = multAdd a (multAdd b c)
proof:
by
  unfold multAdd; grind

name: MultAdd.multAdd_zero
doc: 0 is the identity of mult-add (because 1 is the identity of ×).
proof:
by
  unfold multAdd; grind

name: MultAdd.zero_multAdd
proof:
by
  unfold multAdd; grind

name: MultAdd.multAdd_excess
doc: Mult-add is never less than its two pieces added: the corner a·b is extra.
statement: multAdd a b = (a + b) + a * b
proof: rfl

name: MultAdd.wAdd_def
statement: wAdd k a b = a + b + k * a * b
proof: rfl

name: MultAdd.wAdd_lift
doc: The weighted lift: 1 + k·(a ⊞ₖ b) = (1 + k·a)(1 + k·b).
statement: 1 + k * wAdd k a b = (1 + k * a) * (1 + k * b)
proof:
by
  unfold wAdd; grind

name: MultAdd.wAdd_scale
doc: Weighted mult-add is plain mult-add seen through x ↦ k·x.
statement: k * wAdd k a b = multAdd (k * a) (k * b)
proof:
by
  unfold wAdd multAdd; grind

name: MultAdd.wAdd_comm
statement: wAdd k a b = wAdd k b a
proof:
by
  unfold wAdd; grind

name: MultAdd.wAdd_assoc
statement: wAdd k (wAdd k a b) c = wAdd k a (wAdd k b c)
proof:
by
  unfold wAdd; grind

name: MultAdd.wAdd_zero
proof:
by
  unfold wAdd; grind

name: MultAdd.wAdd_weight_zero
doc: k = 0: no corner, plain addition.
proof:
by
  unfold wAdd; grind

name: MultAdd.wAdd_one
doc: k = 1: plain mult-add.
statement: wAdd 1 a b = multAdd a b
proof:
by
  unfold wAdd multAdd; grind

name: MultAdd.pw_eq_pow
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [Semiring.pow_zero]; rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [Semiring.pow_succ, pw, ih]

name: MultAdd.pw_add
statement: pw x (m + n) = pw x m * pw x n
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [Nat.add_zero, pw]; grind
  | succ n ih => rw [Nat.add_succ, pw, pw, ih]; grind

name: MultAdd.pw_mul
statement: pw x (m * n) = pw (pw x m) n
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [Nat.mul_zero, pw]
  | succ n ih => rw [Nat.mul_succ, pw_add, ih, pw]

name: MultAdd.pw_one
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [pw, ih]; grind

name: MultAdd.pw_mul_base
statement: pw (x * y) n = pw x n * pw y n
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [pw]; grind
  | succ n ih => rw [pw, pw, pw, ih]; grind

name: MultAdd.pow_add'
statement: a ^ (m + n) = a ^ m * a ^ n
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [Nat.add_zero, Semiring.pow_zero]; grind
  | succ n ih => rw [← Nat.add_assoc, Semiring.pow_succ, Semiring.pow_succ, ih]; grind

name: MultAdd.mul_pow'
statement: (a * b) ^ n = a ^ n * b ^ n
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [Semiring.pow_zero, Semiring.pow_zero, Semiring.pow_zero]; grind
  | succ n ih => rw [Semiring.pow_succ, Semiring.pow_succ, Semiring.pow_succ, ih]; grind

name: MultAdd.one_pow'
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [Semiring.pow_zero]
  | succ n ih => rw [Semiring.pow_succ, ih]; grind

name: MultAdd.mpow_lift
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [Semiring.pow_zero]; simp only [mpow]; grind
  | succ n ih => rw [Semiring.pow_succ, ← ih, mpow, multAdd_lift]

name: MultAdd.mpow_add
doc: Powers add: a^(⊞(m+n)) = a^(⊞m) ⊞ a^(⊞n).
statement: mpow a (m + n) = multAdd (mpow a m) (mpow a n)
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [Nat.add_zero, mpow]; rw [multAdd_zero]
  | succ n ih => rw [← Nat.add_assoc, mpow, mpow, ih, multAdd_assoc]

name: MultAdd.wpow_lift
statement: 1 + k * wpow k a n = (1 + k * a) ^ n
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [Semiring.pow_zero]; simp only [wpow]; grind
  | succ n ih => rw [Semiring.pow_succ, ← ih, wpow, wAdd_lift]

name: MultAdd.wpow_one
statement: wpow 1 a n = mpow a n
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [wpow, mpow, ih, wAdd_one]

name: MultAdd.foldMA_append
doc: The whole is the first part ⊞ the second part.
proof:
by
  induction S with
  | nil => simp only [List.nil_append, foldMA]; rw [zero_multAdd]
  | cons a S ih =>
    simp only [List.cons_append, foldMA]
    rw [ih, multAdd_assoc]

name: MultAdd.foldMA_lift
doc: The list lift: 1 + (x₁ ⊞ … ⊞ xₙ) = (1 + x₁)⋯(1 + xₙ).
proof:
by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp only [foldMA, List.map, prodL]; grind
  | cons a l ih => simp only [foldMA, List.map, prodL]; rw [multAdd_lift, ih]

name: MultAdd.foldMA_perm
doc: Order never matters: any reshuffle gives the same total.
proof:
by
  induction h with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x _ ih => simp only [foldMA]; rw [ih]
  | swap x y l =>
    simp only [foldMA]
    unfold multAdd; grind
  | trans _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact ih₁.trans ih₂

name: MultAdd.sumL_append
statement: sumL (l ++ m) = sumL l + sumL m
proof:
by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp only [List.nil_append, sumL]; grind
  | cons a l ih => simp only [List.cons_append, sumL]; rw [ih]; grind

name: MultAdd.sumL_map_cons
statement: sumL ((gs.map (fun g => a :: g)).map prodL) = a * sumL (gs.map prodL)
proof:
by
  induction gs with
  | nil => simp only [List.map, sumL]; grind
  | cons g gs ih => simp only [List.map, sumL, prodL] at ih ⊢; rw [ih]; grind

side.name: MultAdd.sumL (List.map MultAdd.prodL (List.map (fun g => a :: g) gs))

name: MultAdd.one_add_foldMA_eq_corners
doc: The corner expansion: 1 + (x₁ ⊞ … ⊞ xₙ) is the sum over every corner of the cube (every sub-list) of the product of its entries.
proof:
by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp only [foldMA, groups, List.map, prodL, sumL] <;> grind
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [foldMA, groups, List.map_append]
    rw [sumL_append, sumL_map_cons, ← ih]
    unfold multAdd; grind

name: MultAdd.neg_one_absorbs
doc: The wall: −1 absorbs everything mult-added to it.
proof:
by
  unfold multAdd; grind

name: MultAdd.mpow_eq
doc: The power in closed form: a^(⊞n) = (1 + a)^n − 1.
proof:
by
  have h := mpow_lift a n
  grind

name: MultAdd.wAdd_either
doc: k = −1 is "at least one of two independent events".
proof:
by
  unfold wAdd; grind

name: MultAdd.wAdd_neg_one_mirror
doc: k = −1 is mult-add mirrored: a ⊞₋₁ b = −((−a) ⊞ (−b)).
proof:
by
  unfold wAdd multAdd; grind

name: MultAdd.wAdd_flip
doc: Flipping both signs flips the weight.
proof:
by
  unfold wAdd; grind

name: MultAdd.wpow_neg_one
doc: The weighted power at k = −1: n independent chances, 1 − (1 − a)^n.
proof:
by
  have h := wpow_lift (-1) a n
  have e : (1 + -1 * a) = 1 - a := by grind
  rw [e] at h; grind

name: MultAdd.multAdd_multAddInv
doc: Everywhere but the wall there is an exact way back.
proof:
by
  unfold multAdd multAddInv; grind

name: MultAdd.multAddInv_multAdd
proof:
by
  rw [multAdd_comm]; exact multAdd_multAddInv u h

name: MultAdd.inv_one_add
doc: Under the lift the inverse is the ordinary reciprocal.
proof:
by
  unfold multAddInv; grind

name: MultAdd.no_multAddInv_at_wall
doc: At the wall there is none: nothing mult-adds with −1 to give 0.
proof:
by
  unfold multAdd; grind

name: MultAdd.msub_multAdd
doc: Subtraction undoes mult-add (Fisher's rule for real rates).
proof:
by
  unfold multAdd msub; grind

name: MultAdd.wAdd_wall
doc: The weighted wall: −1/k absorbs everything under ⊞ₖ.
proof:
by
  unfold wAdd; grind

name: MultAdd.Cube.layer_zero_right
proof: by cases n <;> rfl

name: MultAdd.Cube.layer_succ_succ
statement: layer (n + 1) (k + 1) = layer n k + layer n (k + 1)
proof: rfl

name: MultAdd.Cube.layer_eq_zero
statement: ∀ n k, n < k → layer n k = 0
proof:
| 0, 0, h => absurd h (by decide)
  | 0, _ + 1, _ => rfl
  | _ + 1, 0, h => absurd h (by omega)
  | n + 1, k + 1, h => by
    rw [layer_succ_succ, layer_eq_zero n k (by omega), layer_eq_zero n (k + 1) (by omega)]

name: MultAdd.Cube.layer_self
proof:
| 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by rw [layer_succ_succ, layer_self n, layer_eq_zero n (n + 1) (by omega)]

name: MultAdd.Cube.absorb
doc: Absorption: (k+1)·C(n+1,k+1) = (n+1)·C(n,k).
statement: ∀ n k, (k + 1) * layer (n + 1) (k + 1) = (n + 1) * layer n k
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro k
    cases k with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k => simp [layer]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro k
    cases k with
    | zero =>
      have h := ih 0
      rw [layer_succ_succ]
      simp only [layer_zero_right] at h ⊢
      omega
    | succ j =>
      have h1 := ih j
      have h2 := ih (j + 1)
      have hp := layer_succ_succ n j
      rw [layer_succ_succ (n + 1) (j + 1)]
      generalize layer (n + 1) (j + 1) = X at *
      generalize layer (n + 1) (j + 1 + 1) = Y at *
      generalize layer n j = A at *
      generalize layer n (j + 1) = B at *
      subst hp
      grind

name: MultAdd.Cube.fact_pos
proof:
| 0 => by decide
  | k + 1 => Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (fact_pos k)

name: MultAdd.Cube.layer_step
statement: (k + 1) * layer n (k + 1) = (n - k) * layer n k
proof:
by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    rw [layer_eq_zero 0 (k + 1) (by omega)]; simp
  | succ m =>
    cases Nat.lt_or_ge m k with
    | inl h =>
      rw [layer_eq_zero (m + 1) (k + 1) (by omega)]
      have h0 : m + 1 - k = 0 := by omega
      rw [h0]; simp
    | inr h =>
      have ha := absorb m k
      have hp := layer_succ_succ m k
      cases k with
      | zero =>
        simp only [layer_zero_right, Nat.sub_zero] at *
        rw [hp] at ha
        generalize layer (m + 1) 1 = X at *
        generalize layer m 1 = B at *
        grind
      | succ j =>
         
        have ha2 := absorb m (j + 1)
        have hp2 := layer_succ_succ m (j + 1)
        rw [hp2] at ha2
        have hpj := layer_succ_succ m j
        have hsub : m + 1 - (j + 1) = m - j := by omega
        rw [hsub, hpj]
        have hab := absorb m j
        rw [hpj] at hab
        generalize layer m (j + 1 + 1) = C at *
        generalize layer m (j + 1) = B at *
        generalize layer m j = A at *
        have hmj : m = (m - j) + j := by omega
        generalize m - j = d at *
        subst hmj
        grind

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.succ_sadd
statement: sadd (succ a) b = succ (sadd a b)
proof:
by
  refine ind (fun b => sadd (succ a) b = succ (sadd a b)) ?_ ?_ b
  · rw [sadd_zero, sadd_zero]
  · intro b ih; rw [sadd_succ, sadd_succ, ih]

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.zero_sadd
proof:
by
  refine ind (fun b => sadd zero b = succ b) ?_ ?_ b
  · rw [sadd_zero]
  · intro b ih; rw [sadd_succ, ih]

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.sadd_comm
doc: Rung 1 is commutative: two rods joined either way round.
statement: sadd a b = sadd b a
proof:
by
  refine ind (fun b => sadd a b = sadd b a) ?_ ?_ b
  · rw [sadd_zero, zero_sadd]
  · intro b ih; rw [sadd_succ, succ_sadd, ih]

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.sadd_assoc
doc: Rung 1 is associative.
statement: sadd (sadd a b) c = sadd a (sadd b c)
proof:
by
  refine ind (fun c => sadd (sadd a b) c = sadd a (sadd b c)) ?_ ?_ c
  · rw [sadd_zero, sadd_zero, sadd_succ]
  · intro c ih; rw [sadd_succ, sadd_succ, sadd_succ, ih]

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.sadd_right_cancel
proof:
by
  revert h
  refine ind (fun c => sadd a c = sadd b c → a = b) ?_ ?_ c
  · intro h; rw [sadd_zero, sadd_zero] at h; exact succ_inj _ _ h
  · intro c ih h; rw [sadd_succ, sadd_succ] at h; exact ih (succ_inj _ _ h)

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.sadd_ne_zero
proof:
by
  refine ind (fun b => sadd a b ≠ zero) ?_ ?_ b
  · rw [sadd_zero]; exact succ_ne_zero a
  · intro b _; rw [sadd_succ]; exact succ_ne_zero _

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.zero_madd
doc: 0 is a left identity too.
proof:
by
  refine ind (fun b => madd zero b = b) ?_ ?_ b
  · rw [madd_zero]
  · intro b ih; rw [madd_succ, ih, sadd_zero]

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.succ_madd
doc: Growing the box along its other side.
statement: madd (succ a) b = sadd (madd a b) b
proof:
by
  refine ind (fun b => madd (succ a) b = sadd (madd a b) b) ?_ ?_ b
  · rw [madd_zero, madd_zero, sadd_zero]
  · intro b ih
    rw [madd_succ, ih, madd_succ, sadd_succ, sadd_succ, sadd_assoc, sadd_assoc, sadd_comm b a]

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.madd_comm
doc: Mult-add is commutative: the box turned on its side.
statement: madd a b = madd b a
proof:
by
  refine ind (fun b => madd a b = madd b a) ?_ ?_ b
  · rw [madd_zero, zero_madd]
  · intro b ih; rw [madd_succ, succ_madd, ih]

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.madd_sadd
doc: Rung 2 distributes over rung 1 exactly, with no correction term: a ⊕ (b ⊞ c) = (a ⊕ b) ⊞ (a ⊕ c). Two boxes of the same width, stacked.
statement: madd a (sadd b c) = sadd (madd a b) (madd a c)
proof:
by
  refine ind (fun c => madd a (sadd b c) = sadd (madd a b) (madd a c)) ?_ ?_ c
  · rw [sadd_zero, madd_succ, madd_zero]
  · intro c ih; rw [sadd_succ, madd_succ, ih, madd_succ, sadd_assoc]

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.madd_assoc
doc: Mult-add is associative: a 3-D box built two ways.
statement: madd (madd a b) c = madd a (madd b c)
proof:
by
  refine ind (fun c => madd (madd a b) c = madd a (madd b c)) ?_ ?_ c
  · rw [madd_zero, madd_zero]
  · intro c ih; rw [madd_succ, ih, madd_succ, madd_sadd]

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.sadd_is_succ
statement: ∃ z, succ z = sadd x y
proof:
by
  refine ind (fun y => ∃ z, succ z = sadd x y) ?_ ?_ y
  · exact ⟨x, (sadd_zero x).symm⟩
  · intro y ⟨z, hz⟩; exact ⟨sadd x y, (sadd_succ x y).symm⟩

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.succ_add_eq
statement: succ (add x y) = sadd x y
proof: Classical.choose_spec (sadd_is_succ x y)

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.add_zero'
proof: succ_inj _ _ (by rw [succ_add_eq, sadd_zero])

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.add_succ'
statement: add x (succ y) = succ (add x y)
proof: succ_inj _ _ (by rw [succ_add_eq, sadd_succ, succ_add_eq])

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.zero_add'
proof: succ_inj _ _ (by rw [succ_add_eq, zero_sadd])

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.add_comm'
statement: add x y = add y x
proof: succ_inj _ _ (by rw [succ_add_eq, succ_add_eq, sadd_comm])

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.succ_add'
statement: add (succ x) y = succ (add x y)
proof:
by
  rw [add_comm', add_succ', add_comm']

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.add_assoc'
statement: add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)
proof:
by
  apply succ_inj; apply succ_inj
  rw [succ_add_eq, ← succ_sadd, succ_add_eq, sadd_assoc, ← succ_add_eq y z, sadd_succ, succ_add_eq]

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.add_right_cancel'
proof:
by
  apply sadd_right_cancel (c := c)
  rw [← succ_add_eq, ← succ_add_eq, h]

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.madd_is
statement: ∃ z, madd x y = add (add x y) z
proof:
by
  refine ind (fun y => ∃ z, madd x y = add (add x y) z) ?_ ?_ y
  · exact ⟨zero, by rw [madd_zero, add_zero', add_zero']⟩
  · intro y ⟨z, hz⟩
    refine ⟨add z x, ?_⟩
    rw [madd_succ, ← succ_add_eq, hz, add_succ', succ_add', add_assoc' (add x y) z x]

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.madd_eq'
statement: madd x y = add (add x y) (mul x y)
proof: Classical.choose_spec (madd_is x y)

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.mul_zero'
proof:
by
  have h := madd_eq' x zero
  rw [madd_zero, add_zero'] at h
  apply add_right_cancel' (c := x)
  rw [zero_add', add_comm']; exact h.symm

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.mul_succ'
statement: mul x (succ y) = add (mul x y) x
proof:
by
  have h1 := madd_eq' x (succ y)
  rw [madd_succ, ← succ_add_eq, madd_eq', add_succ', succ_add'] at h1
  have h2 := succ_inj _ _ h1
   
  apply add_right_cancel' (c := add x y)
  rw [add_comm' (mul x (succ y)), ← h2, add_assoc', add_comm' (add x y), add_assoc']

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.toN_injective
statement: ∀ {j k : Nat}, toN (N := N) j = toN k → j = k
proof:
| 0, 0, _ => rfl
  | 0, _ + 1, h => absurd h.symm (succ_ne_zero _)
  | _ + 1, 0, h => absurd h (succ_ne_zero _)
  | _ + 1, _ + 1, h => by rw [toN_injective (succ_inj _ _ h)]

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.toN_surjective
proof:
by
  refine ind (fun n => ∃ k, toN k = n) ⟨0, rfl⟩ ?_ n
  intro n ⟨k, hk⟩; exact ⟨k + 1, by rw [toN, hk]⟩

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.toN_bijective
statement: (∀ j k : Nat, toN (N := N) j = toN k → j = k) ∧ (∀ n : N, ∃ k, toN k = n)
proof: ⟨fun _ _ h => toN_injective h, toN_surjective⟩

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.toN_sadd
doc: Counting carries rung 1 to rung 1: (a + b + 1) ↦ a ⊞ b.
statement: toN (N := N) (a + b + 1) = sadd (toN a) (toN b)
proof:
by
  induction b with
  | zero => show toN (a + 0 + 1) = sadd (toN a) zero; rw [sadd_zero]; rfl
  | succ b ih =>
    show toN (a + (b + 1) + 1) = sadd (toN a) (succ (toN b))
    rw [sadd_succ, ← ih]; rfl

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.toN_madd
doc: Counting carries mult-add to mult-add: (a + b + ab) ↦ a ⊕ b.
statement: toN (N := N) (a + b + a * b) = madd (toN a) (toN b)
proof:
by
  induction b with
  | zero => show toN (a + 0 + a * 0) = madd (toN a) zero; rw [madd_zero]; simp
  | succ b ih =>
    rw [show a + (b + 1) + a * (b + 1) = (a + b + a * b) + a + 1 by grind, toN_sadd, ih]
    show _ = madd (toN a) (succ (toN b)); rw [madd_succ]

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.toN_add
statement: toN (N := N) (a + b) = add (toN a) (toN b)
proof:
by
  apply succ_inj; rw [succ_add_eq, ← toN_sadd]; rfl

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.toN_mul
statement: toN (N := N) (a * b) = mul (toN a) (toN b)
proof:
by
  apply add_right_cancel' (c := add (toN a) (toN b))
  rw [add_comm' (mul _ _), ← madd_eq', ← toN_madd, ← toN_add, ← toN_add, Nat.add_comm (a * b)]

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.toN_fromN
proof: Classical.choose_spec (toN_surjective n)

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.fromN_toN
proof: toN_injective (toN_fromN _)

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.recN_zero
proof:
by
  unfold recN; rw [show (zero : N) = toN 0 from rfl, fromN_toN]; rfl

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.recN_succ
statement: recN z s (succ n) = s n (recN z s n)
proof:
by
  unfold recN
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := toN_surjective n
  rw [show succ (toN k) = toN (N := N) (k + 1) from rfl, fromN_toN, fromN_toN]

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.hyp_one
proof:
| 0, x => rfl
  | m + 1, x => by
    show hyp (m + 2) x (hyp (m + 3) x 0) = x
    rw [show hyp (m + 3) x 0 = 1 from rfl]
    exact hyp_one m x

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.lad_lift
doc: Every rung of the fused ladder is the ordinary hyperoperation seen through x ↦ 1 + x: F n a b + 1 = H n (a + 1) (b + 1), for every n.
statement: ∀ n a b, lad n a b + 1 = hyp n (a + 1) (b + 1)
proof:
| 0, a, b => by simp [lad, hyp]
  | n + 1, a, 0 => by
    cases n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ m => rw [hyp_one]; rfl
  | n + 1, a, b + 1 => by
    show lad n a (lad (n + 1) a b) + 1 = hyp n (a + 1) (hyp (n + 1) (a + 1) (b + 1))
    rw [lad_lift n a (lad (n + 1) a b), lad_lift (n + 1) a b]

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.hyp_add
proof:
by
  induction y with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ y ih => show hyp 0 x (hyp 1 x y) = _; rw [ih]; simp [hyp]; omega

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.hyp_mul
proof:
by
  induction y with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ y ih => show hyp 1 x (hyp 2 x y) = _; rw [ih, hyp_add, Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_comm]

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.hyp_pow
proof:
by
  induction y with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ y ih => show hyp 2 x (hyp 3 x y) = _; rw [ih, hyp_mul, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm]

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.lad_one
proof:
by
  have := lad_lift 1 a b; rw [hyp_add] at this; omega

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.lad_two
statement: lad 2 a b = a + b + a * b
proof:
by
  have := lad_lift 2 a b; rw [hyp_mul] at this; grind

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.lad_three
proof:
by
  rw [lad_lift, hyp_pow]

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.ladN_zero_right
statement: ladN (n + 1) a zero = if n = 0 then succ a else a
proof:
by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [ladN, recN_zero]
  | succ m => simp [ladN, recN_zero]

side.name: if n = 0 then MAFound.FusedPeano.succ a else a

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.ladN_succ
statement: ladN (n + 1) a (succ b) = ladN n a (ladN (n + 1) a b)
proof:
by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp only [ladN, recN_succ]
  | succ m => simp only [ladN]; rw [recN_succ]

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.ladN_one
doc: The schema's rung 1 is the primitive ⊞.
statement: ladN 1 a b = sadd a b
proof:
by
  refine ind (fun b => ladN 1 a b = sadd a b) ?_ ?_ b
  · rw [ladN_zero_right, sadd_zero]; rfl
  · intro b ih; rw [ladN_succ, ih, sadd_succ]; rfl

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.ladN_two
doc: The schema's rung 2 is the primitive ⊕.
statement: ladN 2 a b = madd a b
proof:
by
  refine ind (fun b => ladN 2 a b = madd a b) ?_ ?_ b
  · rw [ladN_zero_right, madd_zero]; rfl
  · intro b ih; rw [ladN_succ, ih, ladN_one, madd_succ, sadd_comm]

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.toN_lad
doc: Counting carries the whole ladder over: every model has every rung.
statement: toN (N := N) (lad n a b) = ladN n (toN a) (toN b)
proof:
by
  induction n generalizing b with
  | zero => simp [lad, ladN, toN]
  | succ n ihn =>
    induction b with
    | zero =>
      rw [show toN (N := N) 0 = zero from rfl, ladN_zero_right]
      cases n with
      | zero => simp [lad, ladBase, toN]
      | succ m => rfl
    | succ b ihb =>
      show toN (lad n a (lad (n + 1) a b)) = _
      rw [ihn, ihb, show toN (N := N) (b + 1) = succ (toN b) from rfl, ladN_succ]

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.add_toN_fromN
statement: add x y = toN (fromN x + fromN y)
proof:
by

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.transfer2

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.transfer3

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.mul_comm'
statement: mul x y = mul y x
proof:
transfer2 (P := fun x y => mul x y = mul y x)
    (fun a b => by rw [← toN_mul, ← toN_mul, Nat.mul_comm]) x y

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.mul_assoc'
statement: mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)
proof:
transfer3 (P := fun x y z => mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z))
    (fun a b c => by rw [← toN_mul, ← toN_mul, ← toN_mul, ← toN_mul, Nat.mul_assoc]) x y z

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.mul_add'
statement: mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)
proof:
transfer3 (P := fun x y z => mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z))
    (fun a b c => by rw [← toN_add, ← toN_mul, ← toN_mul, ← toN_mul, ← toN_add, Nat.mul_add]) x y z

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.mul_one'
proof:
by
  rw [← toN_fromN x, ← toN_mul, Nat.mul_one]

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.multAdd_eq
doc: In the derived semiring, a + b + a·b is the primitive ⊕.
statement: a + b + a * b = madd a b
proof: (madd_eq' a b).symm

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.mul_definable
doc: × from S and ⊕: m·n = k exactly when one side is 0 and k = 0, or m = S m', n = S n', k = S k' and m' ⊕ n' = k'.
proof:
by
  unfold ma
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases m with
    | zero => left; simp at h; exact ⟨rfl, h.symm⟩
    | succ m' =>
      cases n with
      | zero => right; left; simp at h; exact ⟨rfl, h.symm⟩
      | succ n' =>
        right; right
        refine ⟨m', n', m' + n' + m' * n', rfl, rfl, ?_, rfl⟩
        rw [← h]; grind
  · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨m', n', k', rfl, rfl, rfl, h⟩)
    · simp
    · simp
    · rw [← h]; grind

rhs.text: m = 0 ∧ k = 0 ∨ n = 0 ∧ k = 0 ∨ ∃ m' n' k', m = m' + 1 ∧ n = n' + 1 ∧ k = k' + 1 ∧ MAFound.FusedPeano.ma m' n' = k'

name: MAFound.FusedPeano.add_definable
doc: + from ×: Julia Robinson's trick (1949). For z ≠ 0, x + y = z exactly when (xz + 1)(yz + 1) = z²(xy + 1) + 1.
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases hz : z = 0
    · left; omega
    · right; refine ⟨hz, ?_⟩; subst h; grind
  · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨hz, h⟩)
    · rfl
    · have e : z * (x + y) = z * z := by
        have : (x * z + 1) * (y * z + 1) = x * y * (z * z) + z * (x + y) + 1 := by grind
        have : z * z * (x * y + 1) + 1 = x * y * (z * z) + z * z + 1 := by grind
        omega
      exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hz) e

name: MAFound.Independence.int_group
statement: A1 (intOps m w) ∧ A2 (intOps m w) ∧ A3 (intOps m w) ∧ A4 (intOps m w)

name: MAFound.Independence.no_M4
proof:
intOps (· * ·) 0
    A1 o ∧ A2 o ∧ A3 o ∧ A4 o ∧ M1 o ∧ M2 o ∧ M3 o ∧ ¬ M4 o := by
  refine ⟨(int_group _ _).1, (int_group _ _).2.1, (int_group _ _).2.2.1,
    (int_group _ _).2.2.2, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a b; simp only [intOps]; exact Int.mul_comm a b
  · intro a b c; simp only [intOps]; exact Int.mul_assoc a b c
  · intro a; simp only [intOps]; exact Int.mul_zero a
  · intro h; have := h 1 0 0; simp only [intOps] at this; omega

  · intro a b; simp only [intOps]; grind
  · intro a b c; simp only [intOps]; grind
  · intro h; have := h 1; simp only [intOps] at this; omega
  · intro a b c; simp only [intOps]; grind

MAFound.Independence.A1 o ∧

name: MAFound.Independence.no_M1
statement: A1 matOps ∧ A2 matOps ∧ A3 matOps ∧ A4 matOps ∧ ¬ M1 matOps ∧ M2 matOps ∧ M3 matOps ∧ M4 matOps
proof:

  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩

  · intro h
    have := h ⟨0, 1, 0, 0⟩ ⟨0, 0, 1, 0⟩
    revert this; decide
  · intro x y z; apply Mat.ext' <;> simp only [matOps, Mat.add, Mat.mul] <;> grind
  · intro x; apply Mat.ext' <;> simp only [matOps, Mat.add, Mat.mul] <;> grind

name: MAFound.MARing.zero_add
proof: by rw [add_comm, add_zero]

name: MAFound.MARing.add_right_cancel
proof:
by
  have := congrArg (· +' −c) h
  simp only [add_assoc, add_neg, add_zero] at this
  exact this

name: MAFound.MARing.add_left_cancel
proof:
by
  rw [add_comm c a, add_comm c b] at h; exact add_right_cancel h

name: MAFound.MARing.add_left_comm
proof:
by
  rw [← add_assoc, add_comm a b, add_assoc]

name: MAFound.MARing.neg_unique
proof:
by
  apply add_left_cancel (c := a); rw [h, add_neg]

name: MAFound.MARing.neg_neg
proof: (neg_unique (neg_add a)).symm

name: MAFound.MARing.neg_zero
proof: (neg_unique (add_zero zero)).symm

name: MAFound.MARing.neg_add_distrib
proof:
by
  symm; apply neg_unique

name: MAFound.MARing.madd_zero
doc: 0 is the identity of mult-add. Not an axiom: cut a box along a side of length 0 and both pieces are the whole box, so the box adds nothing.
proof:
by
  have h := madd_add a zero zero
  rw [add_zero] at h
   
  have h2 : (a ⊞ zero) +' zero = (a ⊞ zero) +' ((a ⊞ zero) +' −a) := by
    rw [add_zero, ← add_assoc]; exact h
  have h3 := add_left_cancel h2
  have h4 := congrArg (· +' a) h3
  simp only [zero_add, add_assoc, neg_add, add_zero] at h4
  exact h4.symm

name: MAFound.MARing.zero_madd
proof: by rw [madd_comm, madd_zero]

name: MAFound.MARing.wall_unique
doc: The wall is unique: any element that absorbs everything is w.
proof:
by
  have h1 := hv wall
  rw [madd_comm, madd_wall] at h1
  exact h1.symm

name: MAFound.MARing.madd_eq
doc: Mult-add is the two edges plus the corner.
proof:
by
  unfold mul
  calc a ⊞ b = a ⊞ b +' (a +' −a) +' (b +' −b) := by rw [add_neg, add_neg, add_zero, add_zero]
    _ = a +' b +' (a ⊞ b +' −a +' −b) := by ac_rfl

name: MAFound.MARing.mul_comm
proof:
by
  unfold mul; rw [madd_comm]; ac_rfl

name: MAFound.MARing.mul_zero
proof:
by
  unfold mul; rw [madd_zero, add_neg, zero_add, neg_zero]

name: MAFound.MARing.zero_mul
proof: by rw [mul_comm, mul_zero]

name: MAFound.MARing.mul_add
doc: Distributivity, from M4.
statement: a ⬝ (b +' c) = a ⬝ b +' a ⬝ c
proof:
by
  unfold mul
  rw [madd_add, neg_add_distrib]
   
  ac_rfl

name: MAFound.MARing.add_mul
statement: (a +' b) ⬝ c = a ⬝ c +' b ⬝ c
proof:
by
  rw [mul_comm, mul_add, mul_comm c, mul_comm c]

name: MAFound.MARing.mul_neg
proof:
by
  apply neg_unique; rw [← mul_add, add_neg, mul_zero]

name: MAFound.MARing.mul_assoc
doc: Associativity of the product, from M2 and M4.
proof:
by
  have h := madd_assoc a b c
  rw [madd_eq a b, madd_eq b c, madd_eq, madd_eq a, add_mul, add_mul, mul_add, mul_add] at h
   
  have h' : (a +' b +' a ⬝ b +' c +' a ⬝ c +' b ⬝ c) +' (a ⬝ b) ⬝ c
          = (a +' b +' a ⬝ b +' c +' a ⬝ c +' b ⬝ c) +' a ⬝ (b ⬝ c) := by
    have e1 : a +' b +' a ⬝ b +' c +' (a ⬝ c +' b ⬝ c +' (a ⬝ b) ⬝ c)
        = (a +' b +' a ⬝ b +' c +' a ⬝ c +' b ⬝ c) +' (a ⬝ b) ⬝ c := by
      ac_rfl
    have e2 : a +' (b +' c +' b ⬝ c) +' (a ⬝ b +' a ⬝ c +' a ⬝ (b ⬝ c))
        = (a +' b +' a ⬝ b +' c +' a ⬝ c +' b ⬝ c) +' a ⬝ (b ⬝ c) := by
      ac_rfl
    rw [← e1, ← e2]; exact h
  exact add_left_cancel h'

name: MAFound.MARing.mul_wall
doc: The wall times anything: a · w = −a.
proof:
by
  unfold mul; rw [madd_wall]
  calc wall +' −a +' −wall = −a +' (wall +' −wall) := by ac_rfl
    _ = −a := by rw [add_neg, add_zero]

name: MAFound.MAField.add_wall_ne
proof:
by
  intro e
  apply h
  have : (a + wall : R) = 0 + wall := by rw [e]; exact (zero_add wall).symm
  exact add_right_cancel this

name: MAFound.MAField.zero_ne_one'
proof:
by
  intro e
  apply zero_ne_wall (R := R)
  have w := wall_eq (R := R)
  rw [zero_eq, w, ← e]; grind

name: MAFound.MAField.mul_inv
proof:
by
  have hb := Classical.choose_spec (way_back (a + wall) (add_wall_ne h))
  have hinv : inv a = 1 + Classical.choose (way_back (a + wall) (add_wall_ne h)) := by
    unfold inv; simp only [h, dite_false]
  rw [hinv]
  generalize Classical.choose (way_back (a + wall) (add_wall_ne h)) = b at hb
  have e := multAdd_eq (a + wall) b
  rw [hb, wall_eq, zero_eq] at e
  grind

name: MAFound.MAField.inv_ne_zero

  intro e

name: MAFound.MAField.inv_inv'

  · rw [h, inv_zero', inv_zero']

    have h2 := mul_inv (inv_ne_zero h)
    calc inv (inv a) = (a * inv a) * inv (inv a) := by rw [h1]; grind
      _ = a * (inv a * inv (inv a)) := by grind
      _ = a := by rw [h2]; grind

name: MultAdd.fexp_iter

proof:
by
  apply lift_inj; rw [fexp_lift, multAdd_lift', fexp_lift, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm]

name: MultAdd.ftet_iter
doc: Rung 4 is rung 3 iterated on the exponent side.
statement: ftet a (b + 1) = fexp a (ftet a b)
proof:
by
  apply lift_inj; rw [ftet_lift, fexp_lift, ftet_lift]; rfl

name: MultAdd.fexp_base_iter
doc: Rung 3 iterated on the base side with a fixed step c: lifts to a double exponential, the discrete flow behind Y' = λ·Y·log Y.
statement: (Nat.repeat (fun x => fexp x c) n a) + 1 = (a + 1) ^ ((c + 1) ^ n)
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [Nat.repeat]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [Nat.repeat]
    rw [fexp_lift, ih, ← Nat.pow_mul, Nat.pow_succ]

side.name: Nat.repeat (fun x => MultAdd.fexp x c) n a

name: MultAdd.pent_pos
proof:
by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [pent]
  | succ n => simp only [pent]; exact tet_pos a _

name: MultAdd.fpent_lift

by
  unfold fpent; have := pent_pos a (b + 1); omega

name: MultAdd.tet_one
proof: by simp [tet]

name: MultAdd.ftet_zero_right
proof: by unfold ftet; simp [tet]

name: MultAdd.ftet_zero_left
proof: by unfold ftet; simp [tet]

name: MultAdd.fpent_zero_right

name: MultAdd.tet_one_base

  | succ n => simp [tet]

name: MultAdd.pent_one_base

by

  | succ n => simp [pent, tet_one_base]

name: MultAdd.fpent_zero_left
proof: by unfold fpent; simp [pent_one_base]

name: MultAdd.fpent_iter
doc: Rung 5 is rung 4 iterated on the exponent side.
statement: fpent a (b + 1) = ftet a (fpent a b)
proof:
by
  apply lift_inj; rw [fpent_lift, ftet_lift, fpent_lift]; simp only [pent]

name: MultAdd.ftet_values

name: MultAdd.ftet_not_assoc

name: MultAdd.ftet_not_comm
proof: by decide

doc: The rung-3 laws stop at rung 4: distributivity over mult-add fails ...

doc: ... and the sum law fails.
proof: by decide

name: AbstractAlgebra.OpIso.self_op
doc: An isomorphism carries "x op x = e" across, so it preserves elements of order ≤ 2.
proof:
by
  rw [← f.map_op, h, f.map_id]

name: AbstractAlgebra.multAdd_commMonoid
proof: ⟨multAdd_comm, multAdd_assoc, multAdd_zero⟩

name: AbstractAlgebra.wAdd_commMonoid
proof: ⟨wAdd_comm k, wAdd_assoc k, wAdd_zero k⟩

name: AbstractAlgebra.mul_commMonoid
statement: CommMonoidLaws (fun a b : R => a * b) 1
proof: ⟨fun a b => by grind, fun a b c => by grind, fun a => by grind⟩

name: AbstractAlgebra.shift_wall
doc: The shift sends the wall −1 to 0, the absorbing element of multiplication.
proof:
by
  show (1 : R) + -1 = 0; grind

name: AbstractAlgebra.multAdd_unit_iff
doc: Units of ⊞ are the quasi-regular elements: a has a ⊞-inverse exactly when 1 + a is invertible for multiplication.
statement: (∃ b, multAdd a b = 0) ↔ (∃ c, (1 + a) * c = 1)
proof:
by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩; exact ⟨1 + b, by rw [← multAdd_lift, hb]; grind⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩; exact ⟨c - 1, by unfold multAdd; grind⟩

name: AbstractAlgebra.wAdd_unit_iff
doc: The same for the weighted law: a is a ⊞ₖ-unit exactly when 1 + k·a is invertible.
proof:
by
  rintro ⟨b, hb⟩; exact ⟨1 + k * b, by rw [← wAdd_lift, hb]; grind⟩

name: AbstractAlgebra.int_multAdd_units
doc: On the integers the ⊞-units are exactly 0 and −2 (the shifts of the units 1 and −1).
statement: (∃ b, multAdd a b = 0) ↔ a = 0 ∨ a = -2
proof:
by
  rw [multAdd_unit_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    have h2 := congrArg Int.natAbs hc
    rw [Int.natAbs_mul] at h2
    have h3 : (1 + a).natAbs = 1 := Nat.eq_one_of_mul_eq_one_right h2
    have := Int.natAbs_eq (1 + a)
    omega
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact ⟨1, by rw [h]; decide⟩
    · exact ⟨-1, by rw [h]; decide⟩

name: AbstractAlgebra.neg_two_self_inverse
doc: −2 is its own ⊞-inverse: the integer group of ⊞-units is the two-element group.
proof: by decide

name: AbstractAlgebra.int_not_group
doc: (Int, ⊞) has no group law: 1 has no inverse.
statement: ¬ ∀ a : Int, ∃ b, multAdd a b = 0
proof:
by
  intro h
  rcases (int_multAdd_units 1).mp (h 1) with h1 | h1 <;> omega

name: AbstractAlgebra.field_unit
doc: On a field every element off the wall is a ⊞-unit.
proof: ⟨multAddInv a, multAdd_multAddInv a h⟩

name: AbstractAlgebra.scale_wall
doc: The scaling carries the weighted wall −1/k to the mult-add wall −1.
proof:
by
  show k * (-1 / k) = -1; grind

name: AbstractAlgebra.int_scale_hom
doc: On the integers x ↦ k·x is an injective homomorphism (Int, ⊞ₖ) → (Int, ⊞): weight k is the sub-monoid kℤ of mult-add.
statement: k * wAdd k a b = multAdd (k * a) (k * b)
proof: wAdd_scale k a b

name: AbstractAlgebra.int_scale_inj
proof: Int.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hk h

name: AbstractAlgebra.int_weight_units
doc: Weight 2: −1 is a unit (its own inverse). Weight −2: 1 is its own inverse.
proof: by decide

name: AbstractAlgebra.parity_is_xor
doc: Weight −2 on {0, 1} is exclusive or.
statement: wAdd (-2 : Int) (if x then 1 else 0) (if y then 1 else 0) = if (x ^^ y) then 1 else 0
proof:
by
  cases x <;> cases y <;> decide

name: AbstractAlgebra.geom_mul
statement: (1 - x) * geom x m = 1 - x ^ m
proof:
by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp only [geom]; rw [Lean.Grind.Semiring.pow_zero]; grind
  | succ m ih => simp only [geom]; rw [Lean.Grind.Semiring.pow_succ]; grind

name: AbstractAlgebra.nilpotent_weight_inverse
doc: If kᵐ = 0, every a has a ⊞ₖ-inverse, namely −a·(1 − ka + (ka)² − …). This is why a nilpotent ideal sits inside the Jacobson radical.
statement: wAdd k a (-a * geom (-(k * a)) m) = 0
proof:
by
  have h1 := geom_mul (-(k * a)) m
  have h2 : (-(k * a)) ^ m = (-a) ^ m * k ^ m := by
    rw [← mul_pow']; congr 1; grind
  rw [h2, hk] at h1
  unfold wAdd
  grind

name: AbstractAlgebra.nilpotent_weight_group
doc: So with a nilpotent weight, (R, ⊞ₖ) is a commutative group.
proof:
{ toCommMonoidLaws := wAdd_commMonoid k
    inv := fun a => ⟨_, nilpotent_weight_inverse k a m hk⟩ }

name: AbstractAlgebra.fin12_group_criterion
doc: (Fin 12, ⊞ₖ) is a group exactly when 6 = 2·3 divides k.
statement: ∀ k : Fin 12, (∀ a : Fin 12, ∃ b : Fin 12, wAdd k a b = 0) ↔ k.val % 6 = 0
proof: by decide

name: AbstractAlgebra.fin8_group_criterion
doc: The same criterion mod 8 (2 must divide k) and mod 9 (3 must divide k).
statement: ∀ k : Fin 8, (∀ a : Fin 8, ∃ b : Fin 8, wAdd k a b = 0) ↔ k.val % 2 = 0
proof: by decide

name: AbstractAlgebra.fin9_group_criterion
statement: ∀ k : Fin 9, (∀ a : Fin 9, ∃ b : Fin 9, wAdd k a b = 0) ↔ k.val % 3 = 0
proof: by decide

name: AbstractAlgebra.fin12_units
doc: Units of (Fin 12, ⊞) are 0, 4, 6, 10: the units 1, 5, 7, 11 of (Fin 12, ·) shifted down.
statement: ∀ a : Fin 12, (∃ b : Fin 12, multAdd a b = 0) ↔ (a = 0 ∨ a = 4 ∨ a = 6 ∨ a = 10)
proof: by decide

name: AbstractAlgebra.fin12_wall
doc: (Fin 12, ⊞) is never a group: the wall 11 = −1 absorbs.
proof: by decide

name: AbstractAlgebra.fin4_klein
doc: (Fin 4, ⊞₂): every element is its own inverse (the Klein four-group).
proof: by decide

name: AbstractAlgebra.fin4_not_iso_add
doc: So (Fin 4, ⊞₂) and (Fin 4, +) are not isomorphic, though both are groups of order 4.
proof:
by
  intro f
  have h := f.self_op (f.invFun 1) (fin4_klein _)
  rw [f.right] at h
  exact absurd h (by decide)

name: AbstractAlgebra.fin9_cyclic
doc: Mod 9 with weight 3: 1 generates all nine elements (cyclic, like (Fin 9, +)).
statement: wpow (3 : Fin 9) 1 9 = 0 ∧ ∀ j : Fin 9, j.val ≠ 0 → wpow (3 : Fin 9) 1 j.val ≠ 0
proof:
by
  decide

name: AbstractAlgebra.fin8_weight4_cyclic
doc: Mod 8 with weight 4: cyclic of order 8. With weight 2: every element has order ≤ 4.
proof: by decide

name: AbstractAlgebra.fin8_weight2_not_cyclic
proof: by decide

name: AbstractAlgebra.fadd_lift
proof: by unfold fadd; grind

name: AbstractAlgebra.fadd_group
proof:
{ comm := fun a b => by unfold fadd; grind
    assoc := fun a b c => by unfold fadd; grind
    ident := fun a => by unfold fadd; grind
    inv := fun a => ⟨-a - 2, by unfold fadd; grind⟩ }

name: AbstractAlgebra.multAdd_fadd_distrib
doc: Mult-add distributes over shifted addition.
statement: multAdd a (fadd b c) = fadd (multAdd a b) (multAdd a c)
proof:
by
  unfold multAdd fadd; grind

name: AbstractAlgebra.fused_zero_absorbs
doc: The fused zero −1 absorbs under the fused product (it is the wall).
proof: by unfold multAdd; grind

name: AbstractAlgebra.shift_ring_hom
doc: The shift is a ring isomorphism (R, fadd, ⊞) ≅ (R, +, ·): it carries both operations.
proof: ⟨fadd_lift a b, multAdd_lift a b, by grind, by grind⟩

name: AbstractAlgebra.multAdd_not_distrib_add
doc: Plain addition and mult-add do not form a ring: ⊞ does not distribute over +.
proof: by decide

name: AbstractAlgebra.mpow_multAdd
doc: (a ⊞ b)^⊞n = a^⊞n ⊞ b^⊞n: each power map is an endomorphism of mult-add.
statement: mpow (multAdd a b) n = multAdd (mpow a n) (mpow b n)
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [mpow]; rw [multAdd_zero]
  | succ n ih => simp only [mpow]; rw [ih]; unfold multAdd; grind

name: AbstractAlgebra.mpow_mul
doc: (a^⊞m)^⊞n = a^⊞(m·n): composing power maps multiplies the exponents.
statement: mpow (mpow a m) n = mpow a (m * n)
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [mpow, Nat.mul_zero]
  | succ n ih => rw [Nat.mul_succ, mpow_add a (m * n) m, ← ih]; rfl

name: AbstractAlgebra.mpow_one
proof: by simp only [mpow]; rw [zero_multAdd]

name: AbstractAlgebra.mpow_zero_base
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [mpow]; rw [ih, multAdd_zero]

name: AbstractAlgebra.tateRel_symm
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨m, n, h⟩ := h; exact ⟨n, m, h.symm⟩

name: AbstractAlgebra.tateRel_trans
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨m, n, h₁⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨r, s, h₂⟩ := h₂
  refine ⟨m + r, s + n, ?_⟩
  rw [pow_add', pow_add']
  calc (1 + a) * (q ^ m * q ^ r) = ((1 + a) * q ^ m) * q ^ r := by grind
    _ = ((1 + b) * q ^ r) * q ^ n := by rw [h₁]; grind
    _ = (1 + c) * (q ^ s * q ^ n) := by rw [h₂]; grind

name: AbstractAlgebra.tate_glue
doc: The glued point: q − 1 sits with 0, i.e. multiplying the lift by q changes nothing. (Stated as 1 + 0 multiplied by q equals 1 + a whenever 1 + a = q.)
proof: ⟨0, 1, by rw [h, Lean.Grind.Semiring.pow_zero, Lean.Grind.Semiring.pow_succ, Lean.Grind.Semiring.pow_zero]; rw [Lean.Grind.Semiring.add_zero, Lean.Grind.Semiring.mul_one, Lean.Grind.Semiring.one_mul, Lean.Grind.Semiring.one_mul]⟩

name: AbstractAlgebra.tateRel_multAdd
doc: Mult-add respects the gluing on each side.
statement: tateRel q (multAdd a b) (multAdd a' b')
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨m, n, ha⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨r, s, hb⟩ := hb
  refine ⟨m + r, n + s, ?_⟩
  rw [multAdd_lift, multAdd_lift, pow_add', pow_add']
  calc (1 + a) * (1 + b) * (q ^ m * q ^ r) = ((1 + a) * q ^ m) * ((1 + b) * q ^ r) := by grind
    _ = ((1 + a') * q ^ n) * ((1 + b') * q ^ s) := by rw [ha, hb]
    _ = (1 + a') * (1 + b') * (q ^ n * q ^ s) := by grind

lean_shape.text: AbstractAlgebra.tateRel q (MultAdd.multAdd a b) (MultAdd.multAdd a' b')

name: AbstractAlgebra.tateQ_commMonoid
doc: The Tate quotient is a commutative monoid under mult-add.
statement: CommMonoidLaws (TateQ.op q) (TateQ.zero q) where comm x y
proof:
by
    induction x using Quotient.inductionOn; induction y using Quotient.inductionOn
    exact congrArg (Quotient.mk _) (multAdd_comm _ _)
  assoc x y z := by
    induction x using Quotient.inductionOn; induction y using Quotient.inductionOn
    induction z using Quotient.inductionOn
    exact congrArg (Quotient.mk _) (multAdd_assoc _ _ _)
  ident x := by
    induction x using Quotient.inductionOn
    exact congrArg (Quotient.mk _) (multAdd_zero _)

name: AbstractAlgebra.tateQ_glued
doc: In the quotient the class of q − 1 is the identity.
statement: (Quotient.mk (tateSetoid q) a : TateQ q) = TateQ.zero q
proof: Quotient.sound (tate_glue q a h)

name: AbstractAlgebra.tateQ_inverse
doc: On a field, every class off the wall has an inverse in the Tate quotient.
statement: TateQ.op q (Quotient.mk (tateSetoid q) a) (Quotient.mk (tateSetoid q) (multAddInv a)) = TateQ.zero q
proof: congrArg (Quotient.mk _) (multAdd_multAddInv a h)

side.name:
AbstractAlgebra.TateQ.op q (Quotient.mk (AbstractAlgebra.tateSetoid q) a)
  (Quotient.mk (AbstractAlgebra.tateSetoid q) (MultAdd.multAddInv a))

name: AbstractAlgebra.slope_walls_mod5
doc: Walls of slope addition (a + b)/(1 − ab) are the roots of 1 + a². Mod 5 and 13 there are two (two-walled country, a split torus with p − 1 points); mod 3, 7, 11 none (turning country, a non-split torus with p + 1 points). Split exactly at p ≡ 1 mod 4.
proof: by decide

name: AbstractAlgebra.slope_walls_mod13
proof: by decide

name: AbstractAlgebra.slope_no_walls_mod3
proof: by decide

name: AbstractAlgebra.slope_no_walls_mod7
proof: by decide

name: AbstractAlgebra.slope_no_walls_mod11
proof: by decide

name: AbstractAlgebra.multAdd_one_wall_mod7
doc: Mult-add mod p always has exactly one finite wall, −1 (the other wall is at infinity).
proof: by decide

name: MultAdd.Calculus.mint_lift
doc: Under the lift the mult-add integral is a product integral.
statement: 1 + mint d n = liftProd d n
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [mint, liftProd]; grind
  | succ n ih => rw [mint, liftProd, multAdd_lift, ih]

name: MultAdd.Calculus.ftc_step
doc: Fundamental theorem, part 1: the last step of the integral is the integrand.
statement: mint d (n + 1) = multAdd (mint d n) (d n)
proof: rfl

name: MultAdd.Calculus.ftc
doc: Fundamental theorem, part 2: a path whose mult-add steps are d ends at its start ⊞ the integral of d.
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [mint]; rw [multAdd_zero]
  | succ n ih => rw [h n, ih, mint, multAdd_assoc]

name: MultAdd.Calculus.ftc_box
doc: The same in box form: the end box is the start box times every step.
statement: 1 + f n = (1 + f 0) * liftProd d n
proof:
by
  rw [ftc f d h n, multAdd_lift, mint_lift]

name: MultAdd.Calculus.mint_const
doc: Straight lines are exponentials: constant mult-add slope a gives a^(⊞n).
statement: mint (fun _ => a) n = mpow a n
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [mint, mpow, ih]

name: MultAdd.Calculus.mint_add
doc: The integral over two intervals joins by mult-add.
statement: mint d (a + b) = multAdd (mint d a) (mint (fun j => d (a + j)) b)
proof:
by
  induction b with
  | zero => simp only [Nat.add_zero, mint]; rw [multAdd_zero]
  | succ b ih => rw [← Nat.add_assoc, mint, mint, ih, multAdd_assoc]

name: MultAdd.Calculus.product_rule_step
doc: Product rule = sum rule: if f steps by d and g steps by e, then f ⊞ g steps by d ⊞ e.
statement: multAdd (f (k + 1)) (g (k + 1)) = multAdd (multAdd (f k) (g k)) (multAdd (d k) (e k))
proof:
by
  rw [hf, hg]; unfold multAdd; grind

name: MultAdd.Calculus.mint_multAdd
doc: The integral of d ⊞ e is the integral of d ⊞ the integral of e.
statement: mint (fun k => multAdd (d k) (e k)) n = multAdd (mint d n) (mint e n)
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [mint]; rw [multAdd_zero]
  | succ n ih => rw [mint, mint, mint, ih]; unfold multAdd; grind

side.name: MultAdd.Calculus.mint (fun k => MultAdd.multAdd (d k) (e k)) n

name: MultAdd.Calculus.mpow_mul
doc: Chain rule for blocks: n blocks of m equal steps is a power of a power.
statement: mpow a (m * n) = mpow (mpow a m) n
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [Nat.mul_succ, mpow_add, ih, mpow]

name: MultAdd.Calculus.rate_product
doc: If F grows by the factor (1 + h·p) over a step of size h and G by (1 + h·q), then F·G grows by (1 + h·(p ⊞ₕ q)): relative rates combine by weighted mult-add with weight h. This is time-scale ⊕.
statement: F' * G' = (F * G) * (1 + h * wAdd h p q)
proof:
by
  rw [hF, hG, wAdd_lift]; grind

name: MultAdd.Calculus.rate_product_limit
doc: Weight 0 (step size 0) is ordinary calculus: rates just add.
proof: wAdd_weight_zero p q

name: MultAdd.Calculus.ts_exp
doc: The time-scale exponential after n steps: 1 + h·p^(⊞ₕn) = (1 + h·p)ⁿ.
statement: 1 + h * wpow h p n = (1 + h * p) ^ n
proof: wpow_lift h p n

name: MultAdd.Calculus.ts_exp_mul
doc: e_p · e_q = e_(p ⊞ₕ q): the exponential turns weighted mult-add into ×.
statement: (1 + h * wpow h p n) * (1 + h * wpow h q n) = 1 + h * wpow h (wAdd h p q) n
proof:
by
  rw [ts_exp, ts_exp, ts_exp, ← mul_pow', wAdd_lift]

side.name: h * MultAdd.wpow h (MultAdd.wAdd h p q) n

name: MultAdd.Calculus.step_iff
doc: Ordinary slope = height × mult-add slope (the log-derivative rule f' = (1 + f)·r).
statement: f (k + 1) = multAdd (f k) (d k) ↔ diff f k = (1 + f k) * d k
proof:
by
  unfold diff multAdd; constructor <;> intro h <;> grind

name: MultAdd.Calculus.leibniz_corner
doc: Leibniz's rule with the corner kept: the box f·g grows by two strips and one corner square.
statement: diff (fun j => f j * g j) k = diff f k * g k + f k * diff g k + diff f k * diff g k
proof:
by
  unfold diff; grind

side.name: MultAdd.Calculus.diff (fun j => f j * g j) k

name: MultAdd.Calculus.diff_multAdd
doc: The ordinary difference of f ⊞ g: two lifted strips and the corner.
statement: diff (fun j => multAdd (f j) (g j)) k = diff f k * (1 + g k) + (1 + f k) * diff g k + diff f k * diff g k
proof:
by
  unfold diff multAdd; grind

side.name: MultAdd.Calculus.diff (fun j => MultAdd.multAdd (f j) (g j)) k

name: MultAdd.Calculus.diff_pow
doc: An exponential's slope is a times itself, exactly.
statement: diff (fun j => (1 + a) ^ j) n = a * (1 + a) ^ n
proof:
by
  show (1 + a) ^ (n + 1) - (1 + a) ^ n = a * (1 + a) ^ n
  rw [Semiring.pow_succ]; grind

name: MultAdd.Calculus.ftc_add
doc: The additive fundamental theorem: differences telescope.
statement: sumTo (diff f) n = f n - f 0
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [sumTo]; grind
  | succ n ih => rw [sumTo, ih]; unfold diff; grind

name: MultAdd.Calculus.jackson_gap
doc: Stepping the input by mult-add moves it by h·(1 + x): the gap of Jackson's q-derivative with q = 1 + h, read in lifted coordinates.
statement: multAdd x h - x = h * (1 + x)
proof:
by
  unfold multAdd; grind

name: MultAdd.Calculus.mslope_step
doc: Away from the wall, the mult-add slope is the step: f(k) ⊞ slope = f(k+1).
proof:
by
  unfold mslope; rw [multAdd_comm]; exact msub_multAdd _ _ h

name: MultAdd.Calculus.ftc_mslope
doc: Fundamental theorem with slopes read off: f(n) = f(0) ⊞ ∫ mslope f.
proof: ftc f (mslope f) (fun k => (mslope_step f k (h k)).symm) n

name: MultAdd.Calculus.ts_inverse
doc: Time-scale inverse ⊖p = −p/(1 + h·p): exists exactly off the wall.
proof:
by
  unfold wAdd; grind

name: MultAdd.Calculus.dif_shift
doc: Shifting the input commutes with differencing.
statement: dif k (fun i => f (i + 1)) j = dif k f (j + 1)
proof:
by
  induction k generalizing j with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp only [dif]; rw [ih, ih]

name: MultAdd.Calculus.dif_one
doc: Each difference at 1 is the difference at 0 plus the next difference.
statement: dif k f 1 = dif k f 0 + dif (k + 1) f 0
proof:
by
  simp only [dif]; grind

name: MultAdd.Calculus.isum_add
statement: isum (fun k => g k + h k) m = isum g m + isum h m
proof:
by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp only [isum]; omega
  | succ m ih => simp only [isum] at *; rw [ih]; omega

side.name: MultAdd.Calculus.isum (fun k => g k + h k) m

name: MultAdd.Calculus.isum_congr
statement: isum g m = isum h m
proof:
by
  have : g = h := funext e
  rw [this]

name: MultAdd.Calculus.pascal_sum
doc: Pascal inside a weighted sum: the (n+1)-cube's layers split into two n-cubes.
statement: isum (fun k => (Cube.layer (n + 1) k : Int) * x k) (m + 1) = isum (fun k => (Cube.layer n k : Int) * x k) (m + 1) + isum (fun k => (Cube.layer n k : Int) * x (k + 1)) m
proof:
by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp only [isum, Cube.layer_zero_right]; omega
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [isum, ih]
    simp only [isum, Cube.layer_succ_succ, Int.natCast_add]
    grind

side.name: MultAdd.Calculus.isum (fun k => ↑(MultAdd.Cube.layer n k) * x k) (m + 1)
MultAdd.Calculus.isum (fun k => ↑(MultAdd.Cube.layer n k) * x (k + 1)) m

name: MultAdd.Calculus.newton
doc: Newton's forward formula: f(n) = Σ_{k ≤ n} layer(n,k) · Δᵏf(0).
statement: f n = isum (fun k => (Cube.layer n k : Int) * dif k f 0) (n + 1)
proof:
by
  induction n generalizing f with
  | zero => simp only [isum, Cube.layer_zero_right, dif]; omega
  | succ n ih =>
    have h1 := ih (fun i => f (i + 1))
    rw [h1]
    rw [isum_congr _ (fun k => (Cube.layer n k : Int) * dif k f 0
          + (Cube.layer n k : Int) * dif (k + 1) f 0) (n + 1)
          (fun k => by rw [dif_shift, dif_one]; grind)]
    rw [isum_add, pascal_sum n (fun k => dif k f 0) (n + 1),
      isum.eq_2 (fun k => (Cube.layer n k : Int) * dif k f 0) (n + 1)]
    rw [Cube.layer_eq_zero n (n + 1) (by omega)]
    simp only [Int.natCast_zero, Int.zero_mul, Int.add_zero]

side.name: MultAdd.Calculus.isum (fun k => ↑(MultAdd.Cube.layer n k) * MultAdd.Calculus.dif k f 0) (n + 1)

name: FusedRate.ladder
doc: Ladder lemma: if each rung is the one below it run after one step of `s`, then rung j is the bottom rung run after j steps of `s`. On [1,2] the fused-linear rungs satisfy this with f x = b^x and s x = b^(x-1), which gives H_k(b,x) = b^(s^(k-3)(x)).
statement: ∀ j x, G j x = f (iter s j x)
proof:
| 0, x => by rw [h0]; rfl
  | j + 1, x => by rw [hs, ladder f s G h0 hs j (s x)]; rfl

name: FusedRate.grow
doc: Growth template: if each step multiplies the gap by at least p/q, then after j steps it is at least (p/q)^j times the start.
statement: ∀ j, p ^ j * d 0 ≤ q ^ j * d j
proof:
| 0 => by simp
  | j + 1 => by
      have ih := grow d p q h j
      have hj := h j
      calc p ^ (j + 1) * d 0 = p * (p ^ j * d 0) := by rw [Nat.pow_succ]; rw [Nat.mul_comm (p ^ j) p, Nat.mul_assoc]
        _ ≤ p * (q ^ j * d j) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left p ih
        _ = q ^ j * (p * d j) := by rw [← Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_comm p (q ^ j), Nat.mul_assoc]
        _ ≤ q ^ j * (q * d (j + 1)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hj
        _ = q ^ (j + 1) * d (j + 1) := by rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_assoc]

name: DarkSector.corner_le_quarter
doc: The corner is at most a quarter of the square on the sum: 4ab ≤ (a+b)². In units of the scale s, the extra pull relative to the plain sum is at most (a+b)/4 of it, so it fades as the fields weaken. Dark matter shows up in exactly the opposite place: where fields are weakest.

by
  have h : 0 ≤ (a - b) * (a - b) := by
    rcases Int.le_total 0 (a - b) with h | h
    · exact Int.mul_nonneg h h
    · exact Int.mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos h h
  have e : (a + b) ^ 2 = (a - b) * (a - b) + 4 * (a * b) := by grind
  omega

  simp only [M3.det, M3.add, M3.one, outer3]; grind

name: DialSweep.rank_one_dial3
doc: The matrix determinant lemma: det(I + A·u·vᵀ) = 1 + vᵀ·A·u.
proof:
by
  simp only [M3.det, M3.add, M3.one, M3.mul, outer3]; grind

name: DialSweep.det_charpoly2
doc: det(I + kA) = k²·p_A(−1/k) (2×2), for k ≠ 0.
statement: M2.det (M2.add M2.one (M2.smul k x)) = k * k * charpoly2 x (-1 / k)
proof:
by
  rw [M2.det_one_add_smul]; unfold charpoly2; grind

name: DialSweep.det_charpoly3
statement: M3.det (M3.add M3.one (M3.smul k x)) = -(k * k * k) * charpoly3 x (-1 / k)
proof:
by

name: DialSweep.wall_iff_eigen2
doc: The matrix sits on the wall of weight k exactly when −1/k is an eigenvalue.
statement: M2.det (M2.add M2.one (M2.smul k x)) = 0 ↔ charpoly2 x (-1 / k) = 0

by

  · intro h; grind
  · intro h; rw [h]; grind

name: DialSweep.dial_lens
doc: The landscape lens law comes out of the dial matrix: off the wall 1 − q·ab ≠ 0, (I + aU)(I + bU) = (1 − q·ab)·(I + cU) with c = (a + b + k·ab)/(1 − q·ab).
statement: M2.mul (M2.add M2.one (M2.smul a (dialU k q))) (M2.add M2.one (M2.smul b (dialU k q))) = M2.smul (1 - q * a * b) (M2.add M2.one (M2.smul ((a + b + k * a * b) / (1 - q * a * b)) (dialU k q)))
proof:
by
  apply M2.ext' <;> simp only [M2.mul, M2.add, M2.smul, M2.one, dialU] <;> grind

name: DialSweep.cayley_weighted
doc: The weighted Cayley transform (I + kS)⁻¹(I − kS) is the Cayley transform of k·s.
statement: M2.mul (M2.inv (M2.add M2.one (M2.smul k (M2.skew s)))) (M2.sub M2.one (M2.smul k (M2.skew s))) = M2.cayley (k * s)
proof:
by
  have e : M2.smul k (M2.skew s) = M2.skew (k * s) := by
    apply M2.ext' <;> simp only [M2.smul, M2.skew] <;> grind
  rw [e, M2.cayley]

name: DialSweep.winv
doc: The weighted inverse: off the weighted wall, a ⊞ₖ (−a/(1 + k·a)) = 0.
proof:
by

name: MultAdd.E.layer_mul_fact
doc: **Picking with order.** C(n,k)·k! = n(n-1)…(n-k+1).
statement: ∀ k, layer n k * fact k = fall n k
proof:
| 0 => by simp [layer_zero_right, fact, fall]
  | k + 1 => by
    have ih := layer_mul_fact n k
    have hs := layer_step n k
    show layer n (k + 1) * ((k + 1) * fact k) = fall n k * (n - k)
    rw [← ih, ← Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_comm (layer n (k+1)) (k+1), hs]
    generalize layer n k = A; generalize fact k = F; generalize n - k = d
    grind

name: MultAdd.E.fall_le_pow
statement: ∀ k, fall n k ≤ n ^ k
proof:
| 0 => by simp [fall]
  | k + 1 => by
    show fall n k * (n - k) ≤ n ^ k * n
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul (fall_le_pow n k) (Nat.sub_le n k)

name: MultAdd.E.layer_fact_le
doc: **The layer bound.** C(n,k)·k! ≤ nᵏ: distinct picks are at most all picks.
statement: layer n k * fact k ≤ n ^ k
proof:
by
  rw [layer_mul_fact]; exact fall_le_pow n k

name: MultAdd.E.collisions
doc: **Collisions are few.** n·nᵏ ≤ n·fall n k + C(k,2)·nᵏ: the ordered picks that repeat an axis number at most C(k,2)·nᵏ⁻¹.
statement: ∀ k, k ≤ n → n * n ^ k ≤ n * fall n k + tri k * n ^ k
proof:
| 0, _ => by simp [fall, tri]
  | k + 1, h => by
    have ih := collisions n k (by omega)
    have hF := fall_le_pow n k
    show n * (n ^ k * n) ≤ n * (fall n k * (n - k)) + (tri k + k) * (n ^ k * n)
    have hsplit : n = (n - k) + k := by omega
    have h1 : n * (n * n ^ k) ≤ n * (n * fall n k + tri k * n ^ k) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left n ih
    have h2 : n * (k * fall n k) ≤ n * (k * n ^ k) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left n (Nat.mul_le_mul_left k hF)
    generalize n ^ k = A at *
    generalize fall n k = F at *
    generalize n - k = d at *
    subst hsplit
    grind

name: MultAdd.E.pow2_le_fact
proof:
| 0 => by decide
  | N + 1 => by
    have ih := pow2_le_fact N
    show 2 ^ N * 2 ≤ (N + 2) * fact (N + 1)
    have : 2 ^ N * 2 ≤ fact (N + 1) * (N + 2) := Nat.mul_le_mul ih (by omega)
    rw [Nat.mul_comm (N + 2)]; exact this

name: MultAdd.E.tri_mono
proof:
by
  induction k with
  | zero => have : j = 0 := by omega
            subst this; exact Nat.le_refl _
  | succ k ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j (k + 1) with hj | hj
    · exact Nat.le_trans (ih (by omega)) (by simp [tri])
    · have : j = k + 1 := by omega
      subst this; exact Nat.le_refl _

name: MultAdd.E.bernoulli
doc: **Bernoulli, with room to spare.** (c+1)^(k+2) + (k+1)(c+1)^k ≤ c^(k+2) + (k+2)(c+1)^(k+1).
proof:
| 0 => by simp
  | k + 1 => by
    have ih := bernoulli c k
    have h := Nat.mul_le_mul_left c ih
    show (c + 1) ^ k * (c + 1) * (c + 1) ≤ c ^ (k + 1) * c + (k + 2) * ((c + 1) ^ k * (c + 1))
    rw [Nat.pow_succ] at ih h
    generalize (c + 1) ^ k = X at *
    generalize c ^ (k + 1) = Y at *
    grind

name: MultAdd.E.bernoulli_strict
proof:
by
  have ih := bernoulli c k
  have h := Nat.mul_le_mul_left c ih
  show (c + 1) ^ k * (c + 1) * (c + 1) + (k + 1) * (c + 1) ^ k ≤ c ^ (k + 1) * c + (k + 2) * ((c + 1) ^ k * (c + 1))
  rw [Nat.pow_succ] at ih h
  generalize (c + 1) ^ k = X at *
  generalize c ^ (k + 1) = Y at *
  grind

name: MultAdd.E.stair_nat_lt
doc: **The staircase climbs** (cleared of fractions): (n+1)^(2n+1) < nⁿ·(n+2)^(n+1) for n ≥ 1, i.e. (1+1/n)ⁿ < (1+1/(n+1))ⁿ⁺¹.
proof:
by
  have hb := bernoulli_strict ((m + 1) * (m + 3)) m
  have hc : (m + 1) * (m + 3) + 1 = (m + 2) ^ 2 := by grind
  rw [hc, ← Nat.pow_mul, ← Nat.pow_mul, ← Nat.pow_mul, Nat.mul_pow] at hb
  have e1 : (m + 2) ^ (2 * (m + 2)) = (m + 2) ^ (2 * m) * (m + 2) ^ 4 := by
    have : 2 * (m + 2) = 2 * m + 4 := by omega
    rw [this, Nat.pow_add]
  have e2 : (m + 2) ^ (2 * (m + 1)) = (m + 2) ^ (2 * m) * (m + 2) ^ 2 := by
    have : 2 * (m + 1) = 2 * m + 2 := by omega
    rw [this, Nat.pow_add]
  have e3 : (m + 2) ^ (2 * (m + 1) + 1) = (m + 2) ^ (2 * m) * (m + 2) ^ 3 := by
    have : 2 * (m + 1) + 1 = 2 * m + 3 := by omega
    rw [this, Nat.pow_add]
  have e4 : (m + 1) ^ (m + 2) = (m + 1) * (m + 1) ^ (m + 1) := by rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm]
  rw [e1, e2, e4, Nat.mul_assoc (m + 1)] at hb
  rw [e3]
  have hQ : 0 < (m + 2) ^ (2 * m) := Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
  generalize (m + 2) ^ (2 * m) = Q at *
  generalize (m + 1) ^ (m + 1) * (m + 3) ^ (m + 2) = R at *
  have hb' : (m + 1) * (Q * (m + 2) ^ 3 + Q) ≤ (m + 1) * R := by
    grind
  have := Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left hb' (by omega)
  omega

name: MultAdd.E.rsum_add
statement: ∀ m, rsum (fun k => f k + g k) m = rsum f m + rsum g m
proof:
| 0 => by simp [rsum] <;> grind
  | m + 1 => by simp only [rsum]; rw [rsum_add f g m]; grind

side.name: MultAdd.E.rsum (fun k => f k + g k) m

name: MultAdd.E.rsum_mul
statement: ∀ m, rsum (fun k => c * f k) m = c * rsum f m
proof:
| 0 => by simp [rsum] <;> grind
  | m + 1 => by simp only [rsum]; rw [rsum_mul c f m]; grind

side.name: MultAdd.E.rsum (fun k => c * f k) m

name: MultAdd.E.rsum_shift
statement: ∀ m, rsum f (m + 1) = f 0 + rsum (fun k => f (k + 1)) m
proof:
| 0 => by simp [rsum] <;> grind
  | m + 1 => by rw [rsum, rsum_shift f m]; simp only [rsum]; grind

name: MultAdd.E.rsum_le
statement: ∀ m, (∀ k, k < m → f k ≤ g k) → rsum f m ≤ rsum g m
proof:
| 0, _ => Rat.le_refl
  | m + 1, h => by
    simp only [rsum]
    have := rsum_le f g m (fun k hk => h k (by omega))
    have := h m (by omega)
    grind

name: MultAdd.E.rsum_nonneg
statement: ∀ m, (∀ k, k < m → 0 ≤ f k) → 0 ≤ rsum f m
proof:
| 0, _ => Rat.le_refl
  | m + 1, h => by
    simp only [rsum]
    have := rsum_nonneg f m (fun k hk => h k (by omega))
    have := h m (by omega)
    grind

name: MultAdd.E.rsum_mono
doc: More nonnegative terms, bigger sum.
statement: rsum f m ≤ rsum f m'
proof:
by
  induction m' with
  | zero => have : m = 0 := by omega
            subst this; exact Rat.le_refl
  | succ m' ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge m (m' + 1) with hm | hm
    · have := ih (by omega); have := hf m'; simp only [rsum]; grind
    · have : m = m' + 1 := by omega
      subst this; exact Rat.le_refl

name: MultAdd.E.binomial
doc: **The cube's corner count.** (1 + x)ⁿ = Σₖ C(n,k)·xᵏ.
statement: (1 + x) ^ n = rsum (fun k => (layer n k : Rat) * x ^ k) (n + 1)
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [rsum, layer] <;> grind
  | succ n ih =>
    have hT : rsum (fun k => (layer n (k + 1) : Rat) * x ^ (k + 1)) (n + 1)
        = rsum (fun k => (layer n k : Rat) * x ^ k) (n + 1) - 1 := by
      rw [rsum_shift (fun k => (layer n k : Rat) * x ^ k), rsum, layer_eq_zero n (n + 1) (by omega)]
      simp [layer_zero_right] <;> grind
    have step : rsum (fun k => (layer (n + 1) k : Rat) * x ^ k) (n + 1 + 1)
        = x * rsum (fun k => (layer n k : Rat) * x ^ k) (n + 1)
          + rsum (fun k => (layer n k : Rat) * x ^ k) (n + 1) := by
      rw [rsum_shift]
      have e : (fun k => ((layer (n + 1) (k + 1) : Nat) : Rat) * x ^ (k + 1)) =
          (fun k => x * ((layer n k : Rat) * x ^ k) + (layer n (k + 1) : Rat) * x ^ (k + 1)) := by
        funext k; rw [layer_succ_succ, Rat.natCast_add, Rat.pow_succ]; grind
      rw [e, rsum_add, rsum_mul, hT]; simp [layer_zero_right]; grind
    rw [Rat.pow_succ, ih, step]; grind

side.name: MultAdd.E.rsum (fun k => ↑(MultAdd.Cube.layer n k) * x ^ k) (n + 1)

name: MultAdd.E.le_div_of_mul_le
proof: Rat.not_lt.mp (fun h' => absurd ((Rat.div_lt_iff hc).mp h') (Rat.not_lt.mpr h))

name: MultAdd.E.one_div_nonneg
proof:
by
  rcases Rat.le_iff_lt_or_eq.mp ha with h | h
  · exact le_div_of_mul_le h (by grind)
  · rw [← h]; decide +kernel

name: MultAdd.E.one_div_le_one_div
proof:
by
  have ha : 0 < a := by grind
  apply le_div_of_mul_le hb
  have h1 : 1 / a * b ≤ 1 / a * a := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (one_div_nonneg (Rat.le_of_lt ha))
  have h2 : 1 / a * a = 1 := Rat.div_mul_cancel (Rat.ne_of_gt ha)
  grind

name: MultAdd.E.natcast_ne
proof: fun h' => h (Rat.natCast_eq_zero_iff.mp h')

name: MultAdd.E.fact_cast_pos
proof: Rat.natCast_pos.mpr (fact_pos k)

name: MultAdd.E.inv_pow_mul
statement: ∀ k : Nat, (1 / N) ^ k * N ^ k = 1
proof:
| 0 => by simp
  | k + 1 => by rw [Rat.pow_succ, Rat.pow_succ]; have := inv_pow_mul N hN k; grind

name: MultAdd.E.stair_eq_mpow
proof:
by
  rw [mpow_eq]; unfold stair; grind

name: MultAdd.E.stair_eq_cube
proof: binomial n _

name: MultAdd.E.wt_nonneg
proof:
by
  unfold wt
  have h1 : (0 : Rat) ≤ (layer n k : Rat) := Rat.natCast_nonneg
  have h2 : (0 : Rat) ≤ (1 / (n : Rat)) ^ k := Rat.pow_nonneg (one_div_nonneg Rat.natCast_nonneg)
  have := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 h1
  grind

name: MultAdd.E.wt_le
doc: **Each layer is at most 1/k!.** C(n,k)/nᵏ ≤ 1/k!.
proof:
by
  have hN : (n : Rat) ≠ 0 := natcast_ne (by omega)
  have hu := inv_pow_mul (n : Rat) hN k
  have hb : (layer n k : Rat) * (fact k : Rat) ≤ (n : Rat) ^ k := by
    have := Rat.natCast_le_natCast.mpr (layer_fact_le n k)
    rw [Rat.natCast_mul, Rat.natCast_pow] at this; exact this
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ (1 / (n : Rat)) ^ k := Rat.pow_nonneg (one_div_nonneg Rat.natCast_nonneg)
  have h := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb hu0
  apply le_div_of_mul_le (fact_cast_pos k)
  unfold wt
  generalize (1 / (n : Rat)) ^ k = u at *
  generalize (n : Rat) ^ k = P at *
  generalize (layer n k : Rat) = C at *
  generalize (fact k : Rat) = K at *
  grind

name: MultAdd.E.wt_ge
doc: **Each layer is at least 1/k! minus its collisions.** 1/k! ≤ C(n,k)/nᵏ + C(k,2)/(n·k!).
statement: 1 / (fact k : Rat) ≤ wt n k + (tri k : Rat) / ((n : Rat) * (fact k : Rat))
proof:
by
  have hN0 : (0 : Rat) < (n : Rat) := Rat.natCast_pos.mpr (by omega)
  have hN : (n : Rat) ≠ 0 := Rat.ne_of_gt hN0
  have hK := fact_cast_pos k
  have hu := inv_pow_mul (n : Rat) hN k
  have hc : (n : Rat) * (n : Rat) ^ k ≤ (n : Rat) * ((layer n k : Rat) * (fact k : Rat)) + (tri k : Rat) * (n : Rat) ^ k := by
    have := Rat.natCast_le_natCast.mpr (collisions n k hk)
    rw [← layer_mul_fact] at this
    simp only [Rat.natCast_mul, Rat.natCast_add, Rat.natCast_pow] at this; exact this
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ (1 / (n : Rat)) ^ k := Rat.pow_nonneg (one_div_nonneg Rat.natCast_nonneg)
  have h := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc hu0
  have hK1 : 1 / (fact k : Rat) * (fact k : Rat) = 1 := Rat.div_mul_cancel (Rat.ne_of_gt hK)
  have hNK : 0 < (n : Rat) * (fact k : Rat) := Rat.mul_pos hN0 hK
  have key : (1 / (fact k : Rat) - wt n k) * ((n : Rat) * (fact k : Rat)) ≤ (tri k : Rat) := by
    unfold wt
    generalize (1 / (n : Rat)) ^ k = u at *
    generalize (n : Rat) ^ k = P at *
    generalize 1 / (fact k : Rat) = r at *
    generalize (layer n k : Rat) = C at *
    generalize (fact k : Rat) = K at *
    generalize (tri k : Rat) = T at *
    generalize (n : Rat) = N at *
    have e1 : N * P * u = N := by
      have : N * P * u = N * (u * P) := by grind
      rw [this, hu]; grind
    have e2 : (N * (C * K) + T * P) * u = N * C * K * u + T := by
      have : (N * (C * K) + T * P) * u = N * C * K * u + T * (u * P) := by grind
      rw [this, hu]; grind
    have e3 : (r - C * u) * (N * K) = N * (r * K) - N * C * K * u := by grind
    rw [e3, hK1]; rw [e1, e2] at h; grind
  have := le_div_of_mul_le hNK key
  grind

name: MultAdd.E.stair_le_s
proof:
by
  rw [stair_eq_cube]
  exact rsum_le _ _ _ (fun k _ => wt_le n k hn)

name: MultAdd.E.s_bound
proof:
| 0 => by decide +kernel
  | N + 1 => by
    have ih := s_bound N
    have hP : (0 : Rat) < (2 : Rat) ^ N := Rat.pow_pos (by decide)
    have hf : 1 / (fact (N + 1) : Rat) ≤ 1 / (2 : Rat) ^ N := by
      apply one_div_le_one_div hP
      have := Rat.natCast_le_natCast.mpr (pow2_le_fact N)
      rw [Rat.natCast_pow] at this; exact this
    show rsum (fun k => 1 / (fact k : Rat)) (N + 1) + 1 / (fact (N + 1) : Rat) ≤ 3 - 2 / (2 : Rat) ^ (N + 1)
    have hs : s N = rsum (fun k => 1 / (fact k : Rat)) (N + 1) := rfl
    rw [← hs, Rat.pow_succ]
    generalize (2 : Rat) ^ N = P at *
    generalize 1 / (fact (N + 1) : Rat) = r at *
    have e : 2 / (P * 2) = 1 / P := by grind
    rw [e]; grind

name: MultAdd.E.s_lt_three
doc: **The partial sums never reach 3.**
proof:
by
  have h := s_bound N
  have hP : (0 : Rat) < (2 : Rat) ^ N := Rat.pow_pos (by decide)
  have : (0 : Rat) < 2 / (2 : Rat) ^ N := (Rat.lt_div_iff hP).mpr (by grind)
  grind

name: MultAdd.E.s_mono
proof: rsum_mono _ (fun k => one_div_nonneg (Rat.le_of_lt (fact_cast_pos k))) (by omega)

name: MultAdd.E.s_le_u
proof:
by
  unfold u
  have : 0 ≤ 1 / ((fact N : Rat) * (N : Rat)) :=
    one_div_nonneg (by have := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Rat.natCast_nonneg (a := N)) (Rat.le_of_lt (fact_cast_pos N)); grind)
  grind

name: MultAdd.E.u_step
doc: **The upper partner only comes down.** u (N+1) ≤ u N for N ≥ 1.
proof:
by
  have hF := fact_cast_pos N
  have hN1 : (1 : Rat) ≤ (N : Rat) := by
    have := Rat.natCast_le_natCast.mpr hN; simpa using this
  show rsum (fun k => 1 / (fact k : Rat)) (N + 1) + 1 / (fact (N + 1) : Rat)
      + 1 / ((fact (N + 1) : Rat) * ((N + 1 : Nat) : Rat))
      ≤ rsum (fun k => 1 / (fact k : Rat)) (N + 1) + 1 / ((fact N : Rat) * (N : Rat))
  have e : (fact (N + 1) : Rat) = ((N : Rat) + 1) * (fact N : Rat) := by
    show (((N + 1) * fact N : Nat) : Rat) = _
    rw [Rat.natCast_mul, Rat.natCast_add]; simp
  have e2 : ((N + 1 : Nat) : Rat) = (N : Rat) + 1 := by rw [Rat.natCast_add]; simp
  rw [e, e2]
  generalize (fact N : Rat) = F at *
  generalize (N : Rat) = x at *
  have hgoal : (1 / ((x + 1) * F) + 1 / ((x + 1) * F * (x + 1))) * (F * x) ≤ 1 := by
    have : (1 / ((x + 1) * F) + 1 / ((x + 1) * F * (x + 1))) * (F * x) = x * (x + 2) / ((x + 1) * (x + 1)) := by grind
    rw [this]
    have hpos : (0 : Rat) < (x + 1) * (x + 1) := Rat.mul_pos (by grind) (by grind)
    exact Rat.not_lt.mp (fun h => by have := (Rat.lt_div_iff hpos).mp h; grind)
  have hFx : 0 < F * x := Rat.mul_pos hF (by grind)
  have := le_div_of_mul_le hFx hgoal
  grind

name: MultAdd.E.u_anti
proof:
by
  induction M with
  | zero => omega
  | succ M ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge N (M + 1) with hm | hm
    · exact Rat.le_trans (u_step M (by omega)) (ih (by omega))
    · have : N = M + 1 := by omega
      subst this; exact Rat.le_refl

name: MultAdd.E.stair_le_u
doc: **The ceiling.** Every step of the staircase sits under every u N.
proof:
by
  rcases Nat.le_total n N with h | h
  · exact Rat.le_trans (stair_le_s n hn) (Rat.le_trans (s_mono h) (s_le_u N))
  · exact Rat.le_trans (stair_le_s n hn) (Rat.le_trans (s_le_u n) (u_anti hN h))

name: MultAdd.E.s_le_stair
doc: **The floor.** For n ≥ N, the staircase is within 3·C(N,2)/n of s N.
statement: s N - 3 * (tri N : Rat) / (n : Rat) ≤ stair n
proof:
by
  have hN0 : (0 : Rat) < (n : Rat) := Rat.natCast_pos.mpr (by omega)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : Rat, c = (tri N : Rat) / (n : Rat) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := by
    rw [hc]; exact le_div_of_mul_le hN0 (by have : (0:Rat) ≤ (tri N : Rat) := Rat.natCast_nonneg; grind)
   
  have h1 : rsum (wt n) (N + 1) ≤ stair n := by
    rw [stair_eq_cube]; exact rsum_mono _ (wt_nonneg n) (by omega)
   
  have h2 : rsum (fun k => 1 / (fact k : Rat) + (-c) * (1 / (fact k : Rat))) (N + 1) ≤ rsum (wt n) (N + 1) := by
    apply rsum_le
    intro k hk
    have hg := wt_ge n k hn (by omega)
    have hK := fact_cast_pos k
    have ht : (tri k : Rat) / ((n : Rat) * (fact k : Rat)) ≤ c * (1 / (fact k : Rat)) := by
      have htk : (tri k : Rat) ≤ (tri N : Rat) := Rat.natCast_le_natCast.mpr (tri_mono (by omega))
      apply Rat.not_lt.mp
      intro hlt
      have hNK : 0 < (n : Rat) * (fact k : Rat) := Rat.mul_pos hN0 hK
      have := (Rat.lt_div_iff hNK).mp hlt
      have e : c * (1 / (fact k : Rat)) * ((n : Rat) * (fact k : Rat)) = (tri N : Rat) := by
        rw [hc]; grind
      grind
    grind
  rw [rsum_add, rsum_mul] at h2
  have hs : rsum (fun k => 1 / (fact k : Rat)) (N + 1) = s N := rfl
  rw [hs] at h2
  have h3 := s_lt_three N
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s N := rsum_nonneg _ _ (fun k _ => one_div_nonneg (Rat.le_of_lt (fact_cast_pos k)))
  have h4 : c * s N ≤ c * 3 := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Rat.le_of_lt h3) hc0
  have e : 3 * (tri N : Rat) / (n : Rat) = c * 3 := by rw [hc]; grind
  rw [e]
  grind

name: MultAdd.E.stair_lt_succ
doc: **The staircase climbs.** (1 + 1/n)ⁿ < (1 + 1/(n+1))ⁿ⁺¹ for n ≥ 1.
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  have hA : stair (m + 1) * ((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 1) = ((m + 2 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 1) := by
    unfold stair; rw [← mul_pow']; congr 1
    have : ((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) ≠ 0 := natcast_ne (by omega)
    rw [Rat.natCast_add, Rat.natCast_add] at *; grind
  have hB : stair (m + 2) * ((m + 2 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 2) = ((m + 3 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 2) := by
    unfold stair; rw [← mul_pow']; congr 1
    have : ((m + 2 : Nat) : Rat) ≠ 0 := natcast_ne (by omega)
    rw [Rat.natCast_add, Rat.natCast_add] at *; grind
  have hnat := Rat.natCast_lt_natCast.mpr (stair_nat_lt m)
  simp only [Rat.natCast_mul, Rat.natCast_pow] at hnat
  have e : ((m + 2 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (2 * (m + 1) + 1) = ((m + 2 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 1) * ((m + 2 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 2) := by
    rw [← pow_add']; congr 1; omega
  rw [e, ← hA, ← hB] at hnat
  have hP : (0 : Rat) < ((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 1) := Rat.pow_pos (Rat.natCast_pos.mpr (by omega))
  have hS : (0 : Rat) < ((m + 2 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 2) := Rat.pow_pos (Rat.natCast_pos.mpr (by omega))
  have hPS := Rat.mul_pos hP hS
  apply Rat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right (c := ((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 1) * ((m + 2 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 2)) _ (Rat.le_of_lt hPS)
  generalize ((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 1) = P at *
  generalize ((m + 2 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 2) = S at *
  generalize ((m + 3 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 2) = T at *
  grind

    · have : 45 * s * s ≥ 0 := by

    · subst hs; omega
