name: EntropyNoise.escort_escort
statement: escort b (escort a l) = escort (a * b) l
proof:
by
  unfold escort
  generalize hZ : InfoFused.lsum (l.map (fun y => y ^ a)) = Z at ha ⊢
  have hpow : ∀ x : Rat, (x ^ a / Z) ^ b = x ^ (a * b) / Z ^ b := by
    intro x; rw [div_pow', ← pw_eq_pow, ← pw_eq_pow, ← pw_mul, pw_eq_pow]
  have hsum : InfoFused.lsum ((l.map (fun x => x ^ a / Z)).map (fun y => y ^ b))
      = InfoFused.lsum (l.map (fun x => x ^ (a * b))) / Z ^ b := by
    rw [List.map_map]
    have : (fun y => y ^ b) ∘ (fun x => x ^ a / Z) = (fun y => y / Z ^ b) ∘ (fun x => x ^ (a * b)) := by
      funext x; simp only [Function.comp]; exact hpow x
    rw [this, ← List.map_map, lsum_div]
  rw [hsum, List.map_map]
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro x _
  simp only [Function.comp]
  rw [hpow]
  have hZb : Z ^ b ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero' ha b
  generalize InfoFused.lsum (List.map (fun x => x ^ (a * b)) l) = S
  generalize x ^ (a * b) = X
  generalize Z ^ b = W at hZb
  rw [Rat.div_def, Rat.div_def, Rat.div_def, Rat.div_def, Rat.inv_mul_rev, Rat.inv_inv]
  calc X * W⁻¹ * (W * S⁻¹) = X * S⁻¹ * (W⁻¹ * W) := by grind
    _ = X * S⁻¹ := by rw [Rat.inv_mul_cancel _ hZb]; grind

name: EntropyNoise.collision_parseval
doc: Parseval on the tetrahedron: Σp² = (1 + |λ|²)/4.
proof:
by
  simp only [coll, len2, Pauli.lx, Pauli.ly, Pauli.lz]; grind

name: EntropyNoise.linear_entropy_choi
doc: The Choi state's linear entropy 1 − Σp² is (3 − |λ|²)/4: zero at the corners, largest (3/4) at the centre, constant on spheres about the centre.
proof:
by
  rw [collision_parseval p h]; grind

name: EntropyNoise.midsphere_iff
doc: Σp² ≤ ½ (collision entropy at least one bit) exactly inside the midsphere.
proof:
by
  rw [collision_parseval p h]; constructor <;> intro h' <;> grind

name: EntropyNoise.corner_point
proof:
by
  simp only [corner, Pauli.lx, Pauli.ly, Pauli.lz, coll]; decide +kernel

name: EntropyNoise.centre_point
proof:
by
  simp only [centre, Pauli.lx, Pauli.ly, Pauli.lz, coll]; decide +kernel

name: EntropyNoise.edge_midpoint
doc: The edge midpoint (X with chance ½) is (1, 0, 0): on the cube's face, the sphere and the octahedron at once, with collision sum exactly ½.
statement: edgeMid.lx = 1 ∧ edgeMid.ly = 0 ∧ edgeMid.lz = 0 ∧ coll edgeMid = 1/2 ∧ len2 edgeMid = 1
proof:
by
  simp only [edgeMid, Pauli.lx, Pauli.ly, Pauli.lz, coll, len2]; decide +kernel

name: EntropyNoise.octahedron_in_ball
doc: Octahedron inside the ball: |x| + |y| + |z| ≤ 1 gives x² + y² + z² ≤ 1.
statement: x * x + y * y + z * z ≤ 1
proof:
by
  have hu : u ≤ 1 := by grind
  have hv : v ≤ 1 := by grind
  have hw : w ≤ 1 := by grind
  have a := (mul_bound x x u hx hx' (by grind) (by grind)).1
  have b := (mul_bound y y v hy hy' (by grind) (by grind)).1
  have c := (mul_bound z z w hz hz' (by grind) (by grind)).1
  grind

name: EntropyNoise.ball_in_cube
doc: Ball inside the cube.
proof:
by
  have := sq_nn y; have := sq_nn z; grind

name: EntropyNoise.compose_stays_in_ball
doc: Composition multiplies coordinates (QuantumNoise.comp_lx …), and a coordinate of a real channel lies in [−1, 1]. So composing never leaves the ball …
statement: (ax * bx) * (ax * bx) + (ay * b_y) * (ay * b_y) + (az * bz) * (az * bz) ≤ ax * ax + ay * ay + az * az
proof:
by
  have e1 := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx (sq_nn ax)
  have e2 := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy (sq_nn ay)
  have e3 := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz (sq_nn az)
  grind

name: EntropyNoise.compose_stays_in_octahedron
doc: … nor the octahedron …
statement: (ax * bx ≤ u ∧ -(ax * bx) ≤ u) ∧ (ay * b_y ≤ v ∧ -(ay * b_y) ≤ v) ∧ (az * bz ≤ w ∧ -(az * bz) ≤ w)
proof: ⟨mul_bound ax bx u hx hx' bx1 bx2, mul_bound ay b_y v hy hy' by1 by2, mul_bound az bz w hz hz' bz1 bz2⟩

name: EntropyNoise.compose_stays_in_cube
doc: … nor any cube max|λᵢ| ≤ c about the centre (classical capacity cannot rise).
proof: mul_bound a b c h1 h2 hb1 hb2

name: EntropyNoise.collision_series
doc: Series: the collision sum of a composed channel, through Parseval.
statement: coll (p.comp q) = (1 + (p.lx * q.lx) * (p.lx * q.lx) + (p.ly * q.ly) * (p.ly * q.ly) + (p.lz * q.lz) * (p.lz * q.lz)) / 4
proof:
by
  have ht : (p.comp q).i + (p.comp q).x + (p.comp q).y + (p.comp q).z = 1 := by
    rw [comp_total, hp, hq]; grind
  rw [collision_parseval _ ht]; unfold len2; rw [comp_lx, comp_ly, comp_lz]; grind

name: EntropyNoise.map_sq_outer
statement: (InfoFused.outer xs ys).map (fun t => t * t) = InfoFused.outer (xs.map (fun t => t * t)) (ys.map (fun t => t * t))
proof:
by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp only [InfoFused.outer, List.map_nil]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [InfoFused.outer, List.map_cons, List.map_append, ih, List.map_map]
    congr 1
    apply List.map_congr_left; intro y _; simp only [Function.comp]; grind

side.name: List.map (fun t => t * t) (InfoFused.outer xs ys)
InfoFused.outer (List.map (fun t => t * t) xs) (List.map (fun t => t * t) ys)

name: EntropyNoise.collision_parallel
doc: Parallel (two qubits, independent faults): the 16 joint fault chances' collision sum is the product, so linear entropy composes by the union rule.
statement: InfoFused.lsum ((InfoFused.outer [p.i, p.x, p.y, p.z] [q.i, q.x, q.y, q.z]).map (fun t => t * t)) = coll p * coll q
proof:
by
  rw [map_sq_outer, InfoFused.outer_sum]
  simp only [List.map, InfoFused.lsum, coll]; grind

side.name: InfoFused.lsum (List.map (fun t => t * t) (InfoFused.outer [p.i, p.x, p.y, p.z] [q.i, q.x, q.y, q.z]))

name: EntropyNoise.depol_point
statement: (depol s).lx = 1 - 4/3 * s ∧ (depol s).ly = 1 - 4/3 * s ∧ (depol s).lz = 1 - 4/3 * s
proof:
by
  simp only [depol, Pauli.lx, Pauli.ly, Pauli.lz]; refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> grind

name: EntropyNoise.diagonal_crossings
doc: Along the diagonal (λ, λ, λ) the octahedron's face is λ = 1/3 and the midsphere is λ² = 1/3, so the octahedron is strictly inside there.
proof:
by
  decide +kernel

name: EntropyNoise.bit_collision
doc: One bit-flip channel's collision sum in the polarization λ = 1 − 2p.
proof:
by
  grind

name: EntropyNoise.pattern_linear_entropy
doc: The n-fold fault pattern (a corner of the n-cube) has collision sum cⁿ, so its linear entropy climbs at weight −1: 1 − cⁿ = (1 − c)^{⊕₋₁ n}.
proof:
by
  rw [wpow_neg_one]; grind

name: EntropyNoise.cancellation_hides
doc: The net channel after n stacked flips is purer than its fault pattern: ((1 + x)/2)ⁿ ≤ (1 + xⁿ)/2 for x = λ² in [0, 1].
proof:
| 0 => by simp only [Rat.pow_zero]; grind
  | n + 1 => by
    have ih := cancellation_hides x h0 h1 n
    rw [Rat.pow_succ, Rat.pow_succ]
    have hc : 0 ≤ (1 + x) / 2 := by grind
    have e := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ih hc
    have hxn := pow_nn h0 n
    have hxn1 := pow_le_one' h0 h1 n
    have key : 0 ≤ (1 - x) * (1 - x ^ n) := Rat.mul_nonneg (by grind) (by grind)
    grind

name: EntropyNoise.gap_two
doc: At n = 2 the purity gap is a perfect square.
proof: by grind

name: EntropyNoise.synd_antipodal
doc: Opposite corners give the same syndrome …
statement: ∀ a b c : Bool, synd (!a) (!b) (!c) = synd a b c
proof: by decide

name: EntropyNoise.synd_diagonal
doc: … and corners with the same syndrome are equal or opposite: each syndrome is one body diagonal of the 3-cube.
statement: ∀ a b c d e f : Bool, synd a b c = synd d e f → (a = d ∧ b = e ∧ c = f) ∨ (a = !d ∧ b = !e ∧ c = !f)
proof: by decide

lean_shape.text: a = d ∧ b = e ∧ c = f ∨ a = !d ∧ b = !e ∧ c = !f

name: EntropyNoise.syndromes_total
doc: No alarm: both ends of the main diagonal. Alarm: each of the three other diagonals.
proof: by grind

name: EntropyNoise.no_alarm_polar
proof: by grind

name: EntropyNoise.alarm_polar
proof: by grind

name: EntropyNoise.decoder_failure
doc: The vote picks the lighter end of each diagonal; the failures add up to the top two layers of the cube (QuantumNoise.maj3).
proof: by unfold maj3; grind

name: EntropyNoise.alarm_one_coin
doc: After an alarm, the leftover doubt is exactly one fresh coin of chance p.
statement: p * q * q / (p * q * q + p * p * q) = q
proof:
by
  have e : p * q * q + p * p * q = p * q := by
    have : p * q * q + p * p * q = p * q * (q + p) := by grind
    rw [this]; grind
  rw [e]
  have hpq0 : p * q ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero' hp hq
  rw [Rat.div_def]
  calc p * q * q * (p * q)⁻¹ = q * ((p * q) * (p * q)⁻¹) := by grind
    _ = q := by rw [Rat.mul_inv_cancel _ hpq0]; grind

name: EntropyNoise.chain_rule_pair
doc: The chain rule on one diagonal, for any L with L(xy) = L(x) + L(y) (log is one): a·L(a) + b·L(b) = s·L(s) + [a·L(a/s) + b·L(b/s)] with s = a + b. Entropy of the faults = entropy of the syndrome + entropy left on the diagonal.
statement: a * L a + b * L b = (a + b) * L (a + b) + (a * L (a / (a + b)) + b * L (b / (a + b)))
proof:
by
  have ea : a = (a + b) * (a / (a + b)) := by
    rw [Rat.div_def]
    calc a = a * ((a + b) * (a + b)⁻¹) := by rw [Rat.mul_inv_cancel _ hs]; grind
      _ = (a + b) * (a * (a + b)⁻¹) := by grind
  have eb : b = (a + b) * (b / (a + b)) := by
    rw [Rat.div_def]
    calc b = b * ((a + b) * (a + b)⁻¹) := by rw [Rat.mul_inv_cancel _ hs]; grind
      _ = (a + b) * (b * (a + b)⁻¹) := by grind
  have la : L a = L (a + b) + L (a / (a + b)) := by rw [← hL]; exact congrArg L ea
  have lb : L b = L (a + b) + L (b / (a + b)) := by rw [← hL]; exact congrArg L eb
  rw [la, lb]; grind

name: EntropyNoise.nishimori_tanh
doc: On the Nishimori line e^{−2K} = w = p/(1 − p). Then tanh K = (1 − w)/(1 + w) = 1 − 2p.
proof:
by
  have e1 : 1 - p / (1 - p) = (1 - 2 * p) * (1 - p)⁻¹ := by
    rw [Rat.div_def]
    have : (1 - p) * (1 - p)⁻¹ = 1 := Rat.mul_inv_cancel _ hp
    grind
  have e2 : 1 + p / (1 - p) = (1 - p)⁻¹ := by
    rw [Rat.div_def]
    have : (1 - p) * (1 - p)⁻¹ = 1 := Rat.mul_inv_cancel _ hp
    grind
  rw [e1, e2, Rat.div_def, Rat.inv_inv]
  calc (1 - 2 * p) * (1 - p)⁻¹ * (1 - p) = (1 - 2 * p) * ((1 - p) * (1 - p)⁻¹) := by grind
    _ = 1 - 2 * p := by rw [Rat.mul_inv_cancel _ hp]; grind

name: EntropyNoise.kw_lens_polar
doc: The Kramers–Wannier lens M(t) = (1 − t)/(1 + t) sends λ = 1 − 2p to p/(1 − p).
proof:
by
  have a : 1 - (1 - 2 * p) = 2 * p := by grind
  have b : 1 + (1 - 2 * p) = 2 * (1 - p) := by grind
  rw [a, b, Rat.div_def, Rat.div_def, Rat.inv_mul_rev]
  have : (2 : Rat) * 2⁻¹ = 1 := by decide +kernel
  calc 2 * p * ((1 - p)⁻¹ * 2⁻¹) = (2 * 2⁻¹) * (p * (1 - p)⁻¹) := by grind
    _ = p * (1 - p)⁻¹ := by rw [this]; grind

name: Fermat3.pow_emod_of
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Int.pow_succ, Int.pow_succ, Int.mul_emod, ih, Int.mul_emod ((x % m)^n), Int.emod_emod]

name: Fermat3.cube_mod9
doc: A cube of a number prime to 3 is 1 or 8 mod 9.
proof:
by
  have h3 : x % 3 ≠ 0 := fun e => h (Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero e)
  have : x % 9 = 1 ∨ x % 9 = 2 ∨ x % 9 = 4 ∨ x % 9 = 5 ∨ x % 9 = 7 ∨ x % 9 = 8 := by omega
  rw [pow_emod_of]
  rcases this with e|e|e|e|e|e <;> rw [e] <;> decide

name: Fermat3.case1
doc: **First case**: if 3 does not divide xyz, then x³ + y³ ≠ z³.
proof:
by
  have hx : ¬ (3 : Int) ∣ x := fun d => h (Int.dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (Int.dvd_mul_of_dvd_left d))
  have hy : ¬ (3 : Int) ∣ y := fun d => h (Int.dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (Int.dvd_mul_of_dvd_right d))
  have hz : ¬ (3 : Int) ∣ z := fun d => h (Int.dvd_mul_of_dvd_right d)
  have a := cube_mod9 x hx
  have b := cube_mod9 y hy
  have c := cube_mod9 z hz
  intro e
  generalize x^3 = X at *
  generalize y^3 = Y at *
  generalize z^3 = Z at *
  omega

name: Fermat3.mpow_three
doc: The mult-add cube: mpow s 3 = s³ + 3(s + s²); the middle layers carry the 3.
proof:
by
  rw [mpow_eq]; grind

name: Fermat3.flt3_multAdd_iff
doc: Over ℚ with x ≠ 0: x³ + y³ = z³ iff (y/x)³ is the mult-add cube of z/x − 1.
proof:
by
  rw [mpow_eq]
  constructor
  · intro h; grind
  · intro h; grind

name: Fermat3.cube_mod3
doc: Fermat mod 3: x³ ≡ x.
proof:
by
  have e : x^3 - x = (x - 1) * x * (x + 1) := by grind
  rw [e]
  have : x % 3 = 0 ∨ x % 3 = 1 ∨ x % 3 = 2 := by omega
  rcases this with h|h|h
  · exact Int.dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (Int.dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero h))
  · exact Int.dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (Int.dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero (by omega)))
  · exact Int.dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero (by omega))

name: Fermat3.sum_mod3
doc: Every solution of x³ + y³ = z³ has x + y ≡ z (mod 3).
proof:
by
  have a := cube_mod3 x
  have b := cube_mod3 y
  have c := cube_mod3 z
  have : x + y - z = (z^3 - z) - (x^3 - x) - (y^3 - y) := by grind
  rw [this]
  exact Int.dvd_sub (Int.dvd_sub c a) b

name: Fermat3.dvd_of_dvd_mul_cop
proof:
by
  have := (Int.dvd_mul_gcd_iff_dvd_mul (k := k) (n := n) (m := m)).2 (by rwa [Int.mul_comm])
  rwa [hc, Int.natCast_one, Int.mul_one] at this

name: Fermat3.cop_symm

name: Fermat3.cop_of_dvd_left

name: Fermat3.cop_of_dvd_right
proof: cop_symm (cop_of_dvd_left (cop_symm h) hd)

name: Fermat3.cop_mul_right

name: Fermat3.cop_mul_left
proof: cop_symm (cop_mul_right (cop_symm h1) (cop_symm h2))

name: Fermat3.cop_two_of_odd
proof:
by
  rw [Int.gcd_eq_one_iff]
  intro c h2 ha
  have e : (1 : Int) = a - 2 * (a / 2) := by omega
  rw [e]; exact Int.dvd_sub ha (Int.dvd_mul_of_dvd_left h2)

name: Fermat3.cop_three
proof:
by
  rw [Int.gcd_eq_one_iff]
  intro c h3 ha
  have : a % 3 = 1 ∨ a % 3 = 2 := by omega
  rcases this with e | e
  · have e' : (1 : Int) = a - 3 * (a / 3) := by omega
    rw [e']; exact Int.dvd_sub ha (Int.dvd_mul_of_dvd_left h3)
  · have e' : (1 : Int) = 3 - (a - 3 * (a / 3)) := by omega
    rw [e']; exact Int.dvd_sub h3 (Int.dvd_sub ha (Int.dvd_mul_of_dvd_left h3))

name: Fermat3.three_dvd_of_sq
proof:
by
  have h' := Int.emod_eq_zero_of_dvd h

  have : x % 3 = 0 ∨ x % 3 = 1 ∨ x % 3 = 2 := by omega
  rcases this with e|e|e <;> rw [e] at h' ⊢ <;> revert h' <;> decide

name: Fermat3.three_dvd_of_cube
proof:
by
  have h' := Int.emod_eq_zero_of_dvd h

name: Fermat3.cube_of_mul_cop
doc: If a coprime product a·b is a cube, then a is a cube.
proof:
by
  have h1 : Int.gcd (a^3) (c^3) = (Int.gcd a c)^3 := Int.pow_gcd_pow
  have h2 : Int.gcd (a^3) (c^3) = a.natAbs := by
    have e1 : a^3 = a * a^2 := by grind
    rw [← h, e1, Int.gcd_mul_left, Int.gcd_pow_left_of_gcd_eq_one hc, Nat.mul_one]
  rw [h2] at h1
  have h3 : (a.natAbs : Int) = (Int.gcd a c : Int)^3 := by rw [h1, Int.natCast_pow]
  rcases Int.natAbs_eq a with e | e
  · rw [h3] at e; exact ⟨_, e⟩
  · rw [h3] at e; exact ⟨-(Int.gcd a c : Int), by rw [e]; grind⟩

name: Fermat3.cube_of_mul_cop'

name: Fermat3.cube_of_mul3
doc: Three pairwise coprime factors of a cube are cubes.
proof:
by
  have h' : a * (b * c) = w^3 := by rw [← h, Int.mul_assoc]
  have hcop : Int.gcd a (b * c) = 1 := cop_mul_right hab hac
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := cube_of_mul_cop' h' hcop
  exact ⟨cube_of_mul_cop h' hcop, cube_of_mul_cop he.symm.symm hbc |>.elim (fun d hd => ⟨d, hd⟩),
    cube_of_mul_cop' he hbc⟩

  have : -1 ≤ b ∧ b ≤ 1 := by grind
  omega

name: Fermat3.Eis.units_list
doc: The six units ±1, ±ω, ±ω².
proof:
by
  have h4 := four_N u
  have h1 := sq_nonneg' (2 * u.re - u.im)
  have hb : u.im * u.im ≤ 1 := by omega
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := u
  simp only [N] at h h4 hb
  rcases small_of_sq_le_one hb with e | e | e <;> subst e
  · have : (a + 1) * a = 0 := by grind
    rcases Int.mul_eq_zero.1 this with e | e
    · right; right; right; right; right; congr; omega
    · right; right; right; left; congr
  · have : (a + 1) * (a - 1) = 0 := by grind
    rcases Int.mul_eq_zero.1 this with e | e
    · right; left; congr; omega
    · left; congr; omega
  · have : a * (a - 1) = 0 := by grind
    rcases Int.mul_eq_zero.1 this with e | e
    · right; right; left; congr
    · right; right; right; right; left; congr; omega

name: Fermat3.Eis.div_rem
doc: Division with remainder: the Eisenstein integers are Euclidean for the norm.
statement: ∃ q r, a = q * b + r ∧ N r < N b
proof:
by
  have hn := N_pos hb
  generalize hnd : N b = n at hn
  generalize hw : a * conj b = w
  have hbb : b * conj b = ⟨n, 0⟩ := by rw [mul_conj, hnd]
  have hn2 : 0 < 2 * n := by omega
  have e1 := Int.emod_add_mul_ediv (2 * w.re + n) (2 * n)
  have e2 := Int.emod_add_mul_ediv (2 * w.im + n) (2 * n)
  have m1 := Int.emod_nonneg (2 * w.re + n) (Int.ne_of_gt hn2)
  have m2 := Int.emod_nonneg (2 * w.im + n) (Int.ne_of_gt hn2)
  have l1 := Int.emod_lt_of_pos (2 * w.re + n) hn2
  have l2 := Int.emod_lt_of_pos (2 * w.im + n) hn2
  generalize (2 * w.re + n) / (2 * n) = k1 at *
  generalize (2 * w.im + n) / (2 * n) = k2 at *
  generalize (2 * w.re + n) % (2 * n) = M1 at *
  generalize (2 * w.im + n) % (2 * n) = M2 at *
  refine ⟨⟨k1, k2⟩, a - ⟨k1, k2⟩ * b, by grind, ?_⟩
  generalize hr : a - ⟨k1, k2⟩ * b = r
  have hrc : r * conj b = ⟨w.re - n * k1, w.im - n * k2⟩ := by
    have : r * conj b = a * conj b - ⟨k1, k2⟩ * (b * conj b) := by rw [← hr]; grind
    rw [this, hw, hbb]; ext <;> simp <;> grind
  have hN : N r * n = N ⟨w.re - n * k1, w.im - n * k2⟩ := by
    rw [← hrc, N_mul, N_conj, hnd]
  generalize hS : 2 * (w.re - n * k1) = S
  generalize hT : 2 * (w.im - n * k2) = T
  have hS1 : -n ≤ S := by grind
  have hS2 : S < n := by grind
  have hT1 : -n ≤ T := by grind
  have hT2 : T < n := by grind
  have p1 : 0 ≤ (n - S) * (n + S) := Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega)
  have p2 : 0 ≤ (n - T) * (n + T) := Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega)
  have p3 : 0 ≤ (n - S) * (n - T) := Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega)
  have p4 : 0 ≤ (n + S) * (n + T) := Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega)
  have p5 : 0 < n * n := Int.mul_pos hn hn
  have h4 : 4 * (N r * n) = S * S - S * T + T * T := by
    rw [hN, ← hS, ← hT]; simp only [N]; grind
  have hle : 4 * (N r * n) ≤ 3 * (n * n) := by grind
  apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hcon
  have : n * n ≤ N r * n := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by omega) (by omega)
  omega

name: Fermat3.Eis.bezout_aux
doc: Bezout: every pair has a common divisor that is a combination of the two.
statement: ∀ a b : Eis, (N b).toNat < k → ∃ g s t : Eis, g ∣ a ∧ g ∣ b ∧ g = s * a + t * b
proof:
by
  induction k with
  | zero => intro a b h; omega
  | succ k ih =>
    intro a b hk
    by_cases hb : b = 0
    · subst hb
      exact ⟨a, 1, 0, dvd_refl a, ⟨0, by grind⟩, by grind⟩
    · obtain ⟨q, r, hqr, hr⟩ := div_rem a b hb
      have h0 := N_nonneg r
      obtain ⟨g, s, t, hgb, hgr, hg⟩ := ih b r (by omega)
      refine ⟨g, t, s - t * q, ?_, hgb, by rw [hg, hqr]; grind⟩
      rw [hqr]; exact dvd_add (dvd_mul_left_of q hgb) hgr

name: Fermat3.Eis.bezout
doc: Bezout in ℤ[ω].
statement: ∃ g s t : Eis, g ∣ a ∧ g ∣ b ∧ g = s * a + t * b
proof: bezout_aux _ a b (Nat.lt_succ_self _)

name: Fermat3.Eis.cop_bezout
statement: ∃ s t : Eis, s * a + t * b = 1
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨g, s, t, hga, hgb, hg⟩ := bezout a b
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := h g hga hgb
  exact ⟨v * s, v * t, by rw [← hv, hg]; grind⟩

name: Fermat3.Eis.cube_of_cop
doc: If a coprime product α·β is a cube, then α is a unit times a cube.
statement: ∃ u δ : Eis, IsUnit u ∧ α = u * δ^3
proof:
by
  by_cases hα : α = 0
  · exact ⟨1, 0, ⟨1, by grind⟩, by rw [hα]; grind⟩
  obtain ⟨g, s, t, hga, hgc, hg⟩ := bezout α γ
  have hg3 : g^3 = α * (s^3*α^2 + 3*s^2*α*t*γ + 3*s*t^2*γ^2 + t^3*β) := by
    rw [hg]; grind
  have hgb : Cop g β := fun d hd hb => hcop d (dvd_trans hd hga) hb
  obtain ⟨A, B, hAB⟩ := cop_bezout hgb
  obtain ⟨γ', hγ'⟩ := hgc
  have hα' : α = α * (A * g + B * β)^3 := by rw [hAB]; grind
  have he : α = g^3 * (α * A^3 + γ'^3 * (3*A^2*g^2*B + 3*A*g*B^2*β + B^3*β^2)) := by
    grind
  generalize (α * A^3 + γ'^3 * (3*A^2*g^2*B + 3*A*g*B^2*β + B^3*β^2)) = e at he
  generalize (s^3*α^2 + 3*s^2*α*t*γ + 3*s*t^2*γ^2 + t^3*β) = m at hg3
  have h0 : α * (1 - m * e) = 0 := by grind
  rcases mul_eq_zero h0 with h1 | h1
  · exact absurd h1 hα
  · exact ⟨e, g, ⟨m, by grind⟩, by grind⟩

name: Fermat3.odd_norm
proof:
by
  have hk : p + q = 2 * ((p + q) / 2) + 1 := by omega
  generalize (p + q) / 2 = k at hk
  have e : p^2 + 3*q^2 = 2 * (2*k^2 + 2*k + q^2 - p*q) + 1 := by
    have : p = 2*k + 1 - q := by omega
    subst this; grind
  rw [e]; omega

name: Fermat3.norm_one
doc: The integer heart of the coprimality of p + q√−3 and p − q√−3.
proof:
by
  have hodd := odd_norm hpar
  have hn2 : Int.gcd n 2 = 1 := cop_symm (cop_of_dvd_right (cop_two_of_odd hodd) h1)
  have hp2 : n ∣ p^2 := by
    have : 4 * p^2 = 2 * (2 * p^2) := by grind
    rw [this] at h2
    exact dvd_of_dvd_mul_cop hn2 (dvd_of_dvd_mul_cop hn2 h2)
  have hq2 : Int.gcd n (q^2) = 1 :=
    cop_of_dvd_left (Int.pow_gcd_pow_of_gcd_eq_one (k := 2) (l := 2) hpq) hp2
  have h12 : n ∣ 12 := by
    rw [Int.mul_comm] at h3; exact dvd_of_dvd_mul_cop hq2 h3
  have h3' : n ∣ 3 := by
    have : (12 : Int) = 2 * (2 * 3) := by decide
    rw [this] at h12
    exact dvd_of_dvd_mul_cop hn2 (dvd_of_dvd_mul_cop hn2 h12)
  have hle : n ≤ 3 := Int.le_of_dvd (by decide) h3'
  have : n = 0 ∨ n = 1 ∨ n = 2 ∨ n = 3 := by omega
  rcases this with e | e | e | e
  · subst e; have := Int.zero_dvd.1 h3'; omega
  · exact e
  · subst e; exact absurd h3' (by decide)
  · subst e
    exfalso
    have hp : (3 : Int) ∣ p := three_dvd_of_sq hp2
    obtain ⟨p', hp'⟩ := hp
    have hc : (3 : Int) ∣ c := three_dvd_of_cube ⟨p'^2 * 3 + q^2, by rw [← h, hp']; grind⟩
    obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := hc
    have hq : (3 : Int) ∣ q := by
      apply three_dvd_of_sq
      exact ⟨3 * c'^3 - p'^2, by
        have : (3*p')^2 + 3*q^2 = (3*c')^3 := by rw [← hp', ← hc']; exact h
        grind⟩
    have : (3 : Nat) ∣ Int.gcd p q := Int.dvd_gcd ⟨p', hp'⟩ hq
    rw [hpq] at this
    exact absurd this (by decide)

name: Fermat3.Eis.cube_eq
proof: by grind

name: Fermat3.Eis.cube_int
proof:
by
  rw [cube_eq]; ext <;> simp only [mul_re, mul_im] <;> grind

name: Fermat3.Eis.omega_cube
proof:
by
  rw [cube_eq]; ext <;> simp

name: Fermat3.Eis.even_cube_root
doc: Every cube is the cube of something with even ω-part (something in ℤ[√−3]).
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨x, y⟩ := δ
  have hw : ∀ z : Eis, (⟨0, 1⟩ * z)^3 = z^3 := by
    intro z
    have : (⟨0, 1⟩ * z)^3 = (⟨0, 1⟩ : Eis)^3 * z^3 := by grind
    rw [this, omega_cube]; grind
  by_cases h1 : y % 2 = 0
  · exact ⟨⟨x, y⟩, rfl, h1⟩
  by_cases h2 : (x - y) % 2 = 0
  · refine ⟨⟨-y, x - y⟩, ?_, h2⟩
    have e : (⟨-y, x - y⟩ : Eis) = ⟨0, 1⟩ * ⟨x, y⟩ := by ext <;> simp
    rw [e, hw]
  · refine ⟨⟨y - x, -x⟩, ?_, by simp only; omega⟩
    have e : (⟨y - x, -x⟩ : Eis) = ⟨0, 1⟩ * (⟨0, 1⟩ * ⟨x, y⟩) := by ext <;> simp <;> omega
    rw [e, hw, hw]

name: Fermat3.Eis.cube_sqrt3
proof:
by
  rw [cube_eq]; ext <;> simp only [mul_re, mul_im] <;> grind

name: Fermat3.key_cube
doc: Euler's lemma: if p² + 3q² is a cube, gcd(p, q) = 1 and p + q is odd, then p + q√−3 is a cube: p = a³ − 9ab², q = 3a²b − 3b³.
proof:
by
  let α : Eis := ⟨p + q, 2 * q⟩
  have hN : Eis.N α = p^2 + 3*q^2 := by simp only [Eis.N, α]; grind
  have hprod : α * Eis.conj α = (⟨c, 0⟩ : Eis)^3 := by
    rw [Eis.mul_conj, Eis.cube_int, hN, h]
  have hcop : Eis.Cop α (Eis.conj α) := by
    intro d hd hd'
    apply Eis.isUnit_of_N
    apply norm_one (Eis.N_nonneg d) h hpq hpar
    · rw [← hN]; exact Eis.N_dvd hd
    · have := Eis.N_dvd (Eis.dvd_add hd hd')
      have e : Eis.N (α + Eis.conj α) = 4 * p^2 := by simp only [Eis.N, Eis.conj, α, Eis.add_re, Eis.add_im]; grind
      rwa [e] at this
    · have := Eis.N_dvd (Eis.dvd_sub hd hd')
      have e : Eis.N (α - Eis.conj α) = 12 * q^2 := by simp only [Eis.N, Eis.conj, α, Eis.sub_re, Eis.sub_im]; grind
      rwa [e] at this
  obtain ⟨u, δ, hu, hα⟩ := Eis.cube_of_cop hcop hprod
  obtain ⟨δ', hδ', hev⟩ := Eis.even_cube_root δ
  obtain ⟨x, y⟩ := δ'
  simp only at hev
  have hy : y = 2 * (y / 2) := by omega
  generalize y / 2 = k at hy
  subst hy
  rw [← hδ', Eis.cube_sqrt3] at hα
  have hpre : p + q = (α).re := rfl
  have hpim : 2 * q = (α).im := rfl
  rw [hα] at hpre hpim
  generalize hP : (x-k)^3 - 9*(x-k)*k^2 = P at hpre hpim
  generalize hQ : 3*(x-k)^2*k - 3*k^3 = Q at hpre hpim
  rcases Eis.units_list (Eis.N_of_isUnit hu) with e|e|e|e|e|e <;> subst e <;>
    simp at hpre hpim
  · exact ⟨x - k, k, by omega, by omega⟩
  · exact ⟨-(x - k), -k, by grind, by grind⟩
  all_goals omega

name: Fermat3.cube_mod9_all
proof:
by
  rw [pow_emod_of]
  have : x % 9 = 0 ∨ x % 9 = 1 ∨ x % 9 = 2 ∨ x % 9 = 3 ∨ x % 9 = 4 ∨ x % 9 = 5 ∨
    x % 9 = 6 ∨ x % 9 = 7 ∨ x % 9 = 8 := by omega
  rcases this with e|e|e|e|e|e|e|e|e <;> rw [e] <;> decide

name: Fermat3.cube_ne_two
doc: 2 and −2 are not cubes (cubes mod 9 are 0, 1, 8).
proof:
by
  have := cube_mod9_all x
  constructor <;> intro e <;> rw [e] at this <;> revert this <;> decide

name: Fermat3.cube_mod2
proof:
by
  rw [pow_emod_of]
  have : x % 2 = 0 ∨ x % 2 = 1 := by omega
  rcases this with e|e <;> rw [e] <;> decide

name: Fermat3.eq_zero_of_cube
proof:
by
  have : w * (w * w) = 0 := by rw [← h]; grind
  rcases Int.mul_eq_zero.1 this with e | e
  · exact e
  · rcases Int.mul_eq_zero.1 e with e | e <;> exact e

name: Fermat3.cube_ne_zero
proof: fun e => h (eq_zero_of_cube e)

name: Fermat3.cop_of_cubes
doc: In a solution of x³ + y³ + z³ = 0, gcd(x, y) = 1 forces gcd(y, z) = 1.
proof:
by
  have h1 : ((Int.gcd y z : Int))^3 ∣ x^3 := by
    have a := Int.pow_dvd_pow_iff (n := 3) (by decide) |>.2 (Int.gcd_dvd_left y z)
    have b := Int.pow_dvd_pow_iff (n := 3) (by decide) |>.2 (Int.gcd_dvd_right y z)
    have : x^3 = -(y^3 + z^3) := by grind
    rw [this]; exact Int.dvd_neg.2 (Int.dvd_add a b)
  have h2 := (Int.pow_dvd_pow_iff (by decide)).1 h1
  have : Int.gcd y z ∣ Int.gcd x y := Int.dvd_gcd h2 (Int.gcd_dvd_left y z)
  rw [hxy] at this
  exact Nat.dvd_one.1 this

name: Fermat3.sol_cop
proof: cop_of_cubes hs.2.2.2.1 hs.2.2.2.2

name: Fermat3.sol_swap
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, heq, hxy⟩ := hs
  exact ⟨b, a, c, by grind, cop_symm hxy⟩

name: Fermat3.sol_rot
proof:
by
  have h := sol_cop hs
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, heq, hxy⟩ := hs
  exact ⟨b, c, a, by grind, h⟩

name: Fermat3.odd_of_cop_even
proof:
by
  apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hx
  have : (2 : Nat) ∣ Int.gcd x z :=
    Int.dvd_gcd (Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero (by omega)) (Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero hz)
  rw [h] at this; exact absurd this (by decide)

name: Fermat3.sol_even
doc: Some entry of a primitive solution is even.
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, heq, -⟩ := hs
  have a := cube_mod2 x
  have b := cube_mod2 y
  have c := cube_mod2 z
  generalize x^3 = X at *
  generalize y^3 = Y at *
  generalize z^3 = Z at *
  omega

name: Fermat3.measure_lt
proof:
by
  apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hc
  have h1 : (x * y * z).natAbs ^ 3 ≤ N1^3 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) 3
  have h2 : (x * y * z).natAbs ^ 3 = (x^3).natAbs * (y^3).natAbs * (z^3).natAbs := by
    rw [← Int.natAbs_pow, ← Int.natAbs_mul, ← Int.natAbs_mul]; congr 1; grind
  have hx3 : 0 < (x^3).natAbs := Int.natAbs_pos.2 (cube_ne_zero hx)
  have hy3 : 0 < (y^3).natAbs := Int.natAbs_pos.2 (cube_ne_zero hy)
  have h3 : (z^3).natAbs ≤ (x^3).natAbs * (y^3).natAbs * (z^3).natAbs :=
    Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (Nat.mul_pos hx3 hy3)
  omega

name: Fermat3.par_ab
doc: (p + q) odd forces (a + b) odd in Euler's parametrization.
proof:
by
  apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hc
  have hk : a = b + 2 * ((a - b) / 2) := by omega
  generalize (a - b) / 2 = k at hk
  have e : a^3 - 9*a*b^2 + (3*a^2*b - 3*b^3) = 2 * (-4*b^3 + 12*b*k^2 + 4*k^3) := by
    subst hk; grind
  rw [e] at h; omega

name: Fermat3.cop_of_param
proof:
by
  rw [Int.gcd_eq_one_iff] at hpq ⊢
  intro c ha hb
  apply hpq c
  · have : p = a * (a^2 - 9*b^2) := by rw [hp]; grind
    rw [this]; exact Int.dvd_mul_of_dvd_left ha
  · have : q = b * (3*a^2 - 3*b^2) := by rw [hq]; grind
    rw [this]; exact Int.dvd_mul_of_dvd_left hb

name: Fermat3.step
doc: The descent step (Euler): from a primitive solution with z even, build a smaller one.
statement: ∃ x' y' z', Sol x' y' z' ∧ (x' * y' * z').natAbs < (x * y * z).natAbs
proof:
by
  have hyz := sol_cop hs
  have hxz := sol_cop (sol_rot hs)
  obtain ⟨hx0, hy0, hz0, heq, hxy⟩ := hs
  have hxz' : Int.gcd x z = 1 := cop_symm hxz
  have hxo := odd_of_cop_even hxz' hz
  have hyo := odd_of_cop_even hyz hz
  have hpx : x + y = 2 * ((x + y) / 2) := by omega
  have hqx : x - y = 2 * ((x - y) / 2) := by omega
  generalize (x + y) / 2 = p at hpx
  generalize (x - y) / 2 = q at hqx
  have hx : x = p + q := by omega
  have hy : y = p - q := by omega
  have hsum : 2 * p * (p^2 + 3*q^2) = (-z)^3 := by
    have : x^3 + y^3 = 2 * p * (p^2 + 3*q^2) := by rw [hx, hy]; grind
    grind
  have hz3 : z^3 = -(2 * p * (p^2 + 3*q^2)) := by grind
  have hpq : Int.gcd p q = 1 := by
    rw [Int.gcd_eq_one_iff] at hxy ⊢
    intro c hc1 hc2
    exact hxy c (by rw [hx]; exact Int.dvd_add hc1 hc2) (by rw [hy]; exact Int.dvd_sub hc1 hc2)
  have hpar : (p + q) % 2 = 1 := by omega
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := by
    intro e; subst e
    have : (-z)^3 = 0 := by rw [← hsum]; grind
    exact hz0 (by have := eq_zero_of_cube this; omega)
  have hodd := odd_norm hpar
  have hN1 : 1 ≤ p^2 + 3*q^2 := by
    have := Eis.sq_pos' hp0
    have := Eis.sq_nonneg' q
    grind
  by_cases h3 : (3 : Int) ∣ p
  ·  
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := h3
    have hq3 : ¬ (3 : Int) ∣ q := by
      intro hq
      have : (3 : Nat) ∣ Int.gcd p q := Int.dvd_gcd ⟨r, hr⟩ hq
      rw [hpq] at this; exact absurd this (by decide)
    have hsum' : 18 * r * (q^2 + 3*r^2) = (-z)^3 := by rw [← hsum, hr]; grind
    have hqr : Int.gcd q r = 1 := by
      rw [Int.gcd_eq_one_iff] at hpq ⊢
      intro c hc1 hc2
      exact hpq c (by rw [hr]; exact Int.dvd_mul_of_dvd_right hc2) hc1
    have hpar' : (q + r) % 2 = 1 := by omega
    have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := by intro e; apply hp0; rw [hr, e]; rfl
    have hodd' := odd_norm hpar'
    have hcop : Int.gcd (18 * r) (q^2 + 3*r^2) = 1 := by
      have c2 := cop_two_of_odd hodd'
      have c3 : Int.gcd 3 (q^2 + 3*r^2) = 1 := by
        apply cop_three
        have : ¬ (3 : Int) ∣ q^2 := fun h => hq3 (three_dvd_of_sq h)
        have : q^2 % 3 ≠ 0 := fun e => this (Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero e)
        generalize q^2 = Q at *
        generalize r^2 = R at *
        omega
      have cr : Int.gcd r (q^2 + 3*r^2) = 1 := by
        have : q^2 + 3*r^2 = q^2 + r * (3 * r) := by grind
        rw [this, Int.gcd_add_mul_left_right]
        exact Int.gcd_pow_right_of_gcd_eq_one (cop_symm hqr)
      have : (18 : Int) * r = 2 * 3 * 3 * r := by grind
      rw [this]
      exact cop_mul_left (cop_mul_left (cop_mul_left c2 c3) c3) cr
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := cube_of_mul_cop' hsum' hcop
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := cube_of_mul_cop hsum' hcop
    obtain ⟨a, b, hqa, hrb⟩ := key_cube hc hqr hpar'
    have hab := cop_of_param hqr hqa hrb
    have habpar : (a + b) % 2 = 1 := par_ab (by rw [← hqa, ← hrb]; exact hpar')
    have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by intro e; apply hr0; rw [hrb, e]; grind
    have h27 : w^3 = 27 * (2 * b * (a - b) * (a + b)) := by rw [← hw, hrb]; grind
    obtain ⟨w', hw'⟩ := three_dvd_of_cube ⟨9 * (2 * b * (a - b) * (a + b)), by rw [h27]; grind⟩
    have hm : 2 * b * (a - b) * (a + b) = w'^3 := by
      rw [hw'] at h27; grind
    have o1 : (a - b) % 2 = 1 := by omega
    have o2 : (a + b) % 2 = 1 := by omega
    have g1 : Int.gcd b (a - b) = 1 := by rw [Int.gcd_sub_self_right]; exact cop_symm hab
    have g2 : Int.gcd b (a + b) = 1 := by rw [Int.gcd_add_self_right]; exact cop_symm hab
    have c1 : Int.gcd (2 * b) (a - b) = 1 := cop_mul_left (cop_two_of_odd o1) g1
    have c2 : Int.gcd (2 * b) (a + b) = 1 := cop_mul_left (cop_two_of_odd o2) g2
    have c3 : Int.gcd (a - b) (a + b) = 1 := by
      have : a + b = (a - b) + 2 * b := by omega
      rw [this, Int.gcd_self_add_right]; exact cop_symm c1
    obtain ⟨⟨G, hG⟩, ⟨A, hA⟩, ⟨B, hB⟩⟩ := cube_of_mul3 hm c1 c2 c3
    refine ⟨B, -A, -G, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · intro e; rw [e] at hB; omega
    · intro e; have : A = 0 := by omega
      rw [this] at hA; omega
    · intro e; have : G = 0 := by omega
      rw [this] at hG; exact hb0 (by omega)
    · grind
    · have hBA : Int.gcd B A = 1 := cop_of_pow (n := 3) (by decide) (by rw [← hA, ← hB]; exact cop_symm c3)
      rw [Int.gcd_eq_one_iff] at hBA ⊢
      intro d h1 h2; exact hBA d h1 (Int.dvd_neg.1 h2)
    · apply measure_lt hx0 hy0
      have e1 : (B * -A * -G).natAbs ^ 3 = (2 * b * (a - b) * (a + b)).natAbs := by
        rw [← Int.natAbs_pow]; congr 1; rw [hG, hA, hB]; grind
      have e2 : (z^3).natAbs = (18 * r).natAbs * (q^2 + 3*r^2).natAbs := by
        rw [← Int.natAbs_mul]
        have : z^3 = -(18 * r * (q^2 + 3*r^2)) := by grind
        rw [this, Int.natAbs_neg]
      have e3 : (18 * r).natAbs = 27 * (2 * b * (a - b) * (a + b)).natAbs := by
        have : 18 * r = 27 * (2 * b * (a - b) * (a + b)) := by rw [hrb]; grind
        rw [this, Int.natAbs_mul]; rfl
      have hm0 : 0 < (2 * b * (a - b) * (a + b)).natAbs := by
        apply Int.natAbs_pos.2
        intro e
        rcases Int.mul_eq_zero.1 e with e | e
        · rcases Int.mul_eq_zero.1 e with e | e
          · rcases Int.mul_eq_zero.1 e with e | e
            · omega
            · exact hb0 e
          · omega
        · omega
      have hQ : 1 ≤ (q^2 + 3*r^2).natAbs := by
        have := Eis.sq_nonneg' q
        have := Eis.sq_pos' hr0
        have : 1 ≤ q^2 + 3*r^2 := by grind
        omega
      rw [e1, e2, e3]
      have := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right (27 * (2 * b * (a - b) * (a + b)).natAbs) hQ
      omega
  ·  
    have hcop : Int.gcd (2 * p) (p^2 + 3*q^2) = 1 := by
      have c2 := cop_two_of_odd hodd
      have cp : Int.gcd p (p^2 + 3*q^2) = 1 := by
        have : p^2 + 3*q^2 = 3*q^2 + p * p := by grind
        rw [this, Int.gcd_add_mul_left_right]
        apply cop_mul_right
        · exact cop_symm (cop_three (fun e => h3 (Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero e)))
        · exact Int.gcd_pow_right_of_gcd_eq_one hpq
      exact cop_mul_left c2 cp
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := cube_of_mul_cop' hsum hcop
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := cube_of_mul_cop hsum hcop
    obtain ⟨a, b, hpa, hqb⟩ := key_cube hc hpq hpar
    have hab := cop_of_param hpq hpa hqb
    have habpar : (a + b) % 2 = 1 := par_ab (by rw [← hpa, ← hqb]; exact hpar)
    have ha3 : ¬ (3 : Int) ∣ a := by
      intro h; apply h3
      have : p = a * (a^2 - 9*b^2) := by rw [hpa]; grind
      rw [this]; exact Int.dvd_mul_of_dvd_left h
    have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by intro e; apply hp0; rw [hpa, e]; grind
    have hm : 2 * a * (a - 3 * b) * (a + 3 * b) = w^3 := by rw [← hw, hpa]; grind
    have o1 : (a - 3 * b) % 2 = 1 := by omega
    have o2 : (a + 3 * b) % 2 = 1 := by omega
    have ga : Int.gcd a (3 * b) = 1 :=
      cop_mul_right (cop_symm (cop_three (fun e => ha3 (Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero e)))) hab
    have g1 : Int.gcd a (a - 3 * b) = 1 := by rw [Int.gcd_self_sub_right]; exact ga
    have g2 : Int.gcd a (a + 3 * b) = 1 := by rw [Int.gcd_self_add_right]; exact ga
    have c1 : Int.gcd (2 * a) (a - 3 * b) = 1 := cop_mul_left (cop_two_of_odd o1) g1
    have c2 : Int.gcd (2 * a) (a + 3 * b) = 1 := cop_mul_left (cop_two_of_odd o2) g2
    have c3 : Int.gcd (a - 3 * b) (a + 3 * b) = 1 := by
      have : a + 3 * b = (a - 3 * b) + 2 * (3 * b) := by omega
      rw [this, Int.gcd_self_add_right]
      apply cop_mul_right (cop_symm (cop_two_of_odd o1))
      rw [Int.gcd_sub_self_left]; exact ga
    obtain ⟨⟨G, hG⟩, ⟨A, hA⟩, ⟨B, hB⟩⟩ := cube_of_mul3 hm c1 c2 c3
    refine ⟨A, B, -G, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · intro e; rw [e] at hA; omega
    · intro e; rw [e] at hB; omega
    · intro e; have : G = 0 := by omega
      rw [this] at hG; exact ha0 (by omega)
    · grind
    · exact cop_of_pow (n := 3) (by decide) (by rw [← hA, ← hB]; exact c3)
    · apply measure_lt hx0 hy0
      have e1 : (A * B * -G).natAbs ^ 3 = (2 * p).natAbs := by
        rw [← Int.natAbs_pow]
        have : (A * B * -G)^3 = -(2 * p) := by
          have : (A * B * -G)^3 = -(A^3 * B^3 * G^3) := by grind
          rw [this, ← hA, ← hB, ← hG, hpa]; grind
        rw [this, Int.natAbs_neg]
      have e2 : (z^3).natAbs = (2 * p).natAbs * (p^2 + 3*q^2).natAbs := by
        rw [← Int.natAbs_mul, hz3, Int.natAbs_neg]
      have hp2 : 0 < (2 * p).natAbs := Int.natAbs_pos.2 (by omega)
      rw [e1, e2]
      by_cases hbig : 2 ≤ p^2 + 3*q^2
      · have : 2 ≤ (p^2 + 3*q^2).natAbs := by omega
        have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * p).natAbs this
        omega
      · exfalso
        have hq0 : q = 0 := by
          apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hq
          have := Eis.sq_pos' hq
          have := Eis.sq_pos' hp0
          grind
        subst hq0
        have hp1 : p * p ≤ 1 := by grind
        rcases Eis.small_of_sq_le_one hp1 with e | e | e
        · subst e; exact (cube_ne_two z).1 (by grind)
        · exact hp0 e
        · subst e; exact (cube_ne_two z).2 (by grind)

name: Fermat3.no_sol
doc: No primitive solution exists (infinite descent on |xyz|).
statement: ∀ n : Nat, ∀ x y z : Int, (x * y * z).natAbs = n → ¬ Sol x y z
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro x y z hn hs
    have key : ∀ x y z : Int, Sol x y z → z % 2 = 0 → (x * y * z).natAbs = n → False := by
      intro x y z hs hz hn
      obtain ⟨x', y', z', hs', hlt⟩ := step hs hz
      exact ih _ (hn ▸ hlt) x' y' z' rfl hs'
    rcases sol_even hs with h | h | h
    · exact key y z x (sol_rot hs) h (by rw [← hn]; congr 1; grind)
    · exact key z x y (sol_rot (sol_rot hs)) h (by rw [← hn]; congr 1; grind)
    · exact key x y z hs h hn

name: Fermat3.primitive_of_sol
doc: Reduction to coprime solutions: dividing by gcd(x, y) gives a solution with gcd 1.
proof:
by
  have hg : 0 < Int.gcd x y := Int.gcd_pos_of_ne_zero_left y hx
  generalize hgd : Int.gcd x y = g at hg
  have hdx : (g : Int) ∣ x := hgd ▸ Int.gcd_dvd_left x y
  have hdy : (g : Int) ∣ y := hgd ▸ Int.gcd_dvd_right x y
  obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := hdx
  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hdy
  have hg0 : (g : Int) ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hcop : Int.gcd x' y' = 1 := by
    have := Int.gcd_ediv_gcd_ediv_gcd (i := x) (j := y) (by omega)
    rw [hgd] at this
    rwa [hx', hy', Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left _ hg0, Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left _ hg0] at this
  have hz3 : z^3 = (g : Int)^3 * (x'^3 + y'^3) := by rw [← h, hx', hy']; grind
  have hdz : (g : Int) ∣ z :=
    (Int.pow_dvd_pow_iff (n := 3) (by decide)).1 ⟨x'^3 + y'^3, hz3⟩
  obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := hdz
  refine ⟨x', y', z', ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hcop⟩
  · intro e; apply hx; rw [hx', e]; grind
  · intro e; apply hy; rw [hy', e]; grind
  · intro e; apply hz; rw [hz', e]; grind
  · have hg3 : (g : Int)^3 ≠ 0 := cube_ne_zero hg0
    have : (g : Int)^3 * (x'^3 + y'^3) = (g : Int)^3 * z'^3 := by rw [← hz3, hz']; grind
    exact Int.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hg3 this

name: Fermat3.flt3
doc: **Fermat's Last Theorem for exponent 3** (integers): no nonzero x, y, z with x³ + y³ = z³.
proof:
by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, ha, hb, hc, h', hab⟩ := primitive_of_sol hx hy hz h
  have hs : Sol a b (-c) := ⟨ha, hb, by omega, by grind, hab⟩
  exact no_sol _ a b (-c) rfl hs

name: Fermat3.flt3_nat
doc: **Fermat's Last Theorem for exponent 3** (natural numbers): x³ + y³ ≠ z³ when x, y ≠ 0.
proof:
by
  intro h
  have h' : (x : Int)^3 + (y : Int)^3 = (z : Int)^3 := by exact_mod_cast h
  have hz : (z : Int) ≠ 0 := by
    intro e
    rw [e] at h'
    have h1 : (0 : Int) < (x : Int)^3 := Int.pow_pos (by omega)
    have h2 : (0 : Int) < (y : Int)^3 := Int.pow_pos (by omega)
    grind
  exact flt3 x y z (by omega) (by omega) hz h'

name: Fermat3.flt3_multAdd
doc: In the mult-add picture: for integers x, y, z ≠ 0, (y/x)³ is never the mult-add cube of z/x − 1.
proof:
by
  intro h
  have hx' : (x : Rat) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hx
  have := (flt3_multAdd_iff (x : Rat) y z hx').2 h
  exact flt3 x y z hx hy hz (by exact_mod_cast this)

name: Fermat3.sum_cubes
doc: The sum of two cubes factors: x³ + y³ = (x + y)(x² − xy + y²).
proof: by grind

name: Fermat3.second_factor
doc: The second factor is (x + y)² − 3xy.
proof: by grind

name: Fermat3.gcd_factors
doc: For coprime x, y the two factors of x³ + y³ share only 1 or 3.
statement: Int.gcd (x + y) (x^2 - x*y + y^2) = 1 ∨ Int.gcd (x + y) (x^2 - x*y + y^2) = 3
proof:
by
  have e : x^2 - x*y + y^2 = (-3) * (x*y) + (x + y) * (x + y) := by grind
  have c1 : Int.gcd (x + y) x = 1 := by
    have := Int.gcd_self_add_right x y
    exact cop_symm (this.trans h)
  have c2 : Int.gcd (x + y) y = 1 := by
    have := Int.gcd_add_self_right y x
    exact cop_symm (this.trans (cop_symm h))
  have c3 : Int.gcd (x + y) (x * y) = 1 := cop_mul_right c1 c2
  rw [e, Int.gcd_add_mul_left_right, Int.gcd_mul_left_right_of_gcd_eq_one c3]
  have hd : Int.gcd (x + y) (-3) ∣ 3 := Int.gcd_dvd_natAbs_right _ _
  have hle := Nat.le_of_dvd (by decide) hd
  have : Int.gcd (x + y) (-3) ≠ 0 := Int.gcd_ne_zero_right (by decide)
  have : Int.gcd (x + y) (-3) ≠ 2 := fun e => by rw [e] at hd; exact absurd hd (by decide)
  omega

name: Fermat3.three_dvd_mul
proof:
by
  have h' := Int.emod_eq_zero_of_dvd h
  rw [Int.mul_emod] at h'
  have ha : a % 3 = 0 ∨ a % 3 = 1 ∨ a % 3 = 2 := by omega
  have hb : b % 3 = 0 ∨ b % 3 = 1 ∨ b % 3 = 2 := by omega
  rcases ha with ea|ea|ea
  · exact Or.inl (Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero ea)
  all_goals rcases hb with eb|eb|eb
  all_goals first
    | exact Or.inr (Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero eb)
    | (rw [ea, eb] at h'; exact absurd h' (by decide))

name: Fermat3.exactly_one_three
doc: Second case: in a coprime solution with 3 ∣ xyz, exactly one of x, y, z is divisible by 3.
proof:
by
  have heq : x^3 + y^3 + (-z)^3 = 0 := by grind
  have hyz : Int.gcd y (-z) = 1 := cop_of_cubes heq hxy
  have hxz : Int.gcd x (-z) = 1 := by
    have heq' : y^3 + x^3 + (-z)^3 = 0 := by grind
    exact cop_of_cubes heq' (cop_symm hxy)
  have no2 : ∀ a b : Int, Int.gcd a b = 1 → (3 : Int) ∣ a → (3 : Int) ∣ b → False := by
    intro a b hab ha hb
    have : (3 : Nat) ∣ Int.gcd a b := Int.dvd_gcd ha hb
    rw [hab] at this; exact absurd this (by decide)
  have zn : (3 : Int) ∣ z → (3 : Int) ∣ -z := fun h => Int.dvd_neg.2 h
  rcases three_dvd_mul h3 with h1 | h1
  · rcases three_dvd_mul h1 with h2 | h2
    · exact Or.inl ⟨h2, fun hy => no2 x y hxy h2 hy, fun hz => no2 x (-z) hxz h2 (zn hz)⟩
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨fun hx => no2 x y hxy hx h2, h2, fun hz => no2 y (-z) hyz h2 (zn hz)⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨fun hx => no2 x (-z) hxz hx (zn h1),
      fun hy => no2 y (-z) hyz hy (zn h1), h1⟩)

name: Fermat3.mpow_three_mod3
doc: Mult-add cubes and plain cubes agree mod 3: (1+s)³ − 1 ≡ s³ ≡ s.
proof:
by
  rw [mpow_three]
  have := cube_mod3 s
  have e : s^3 + 3*(s + s^2) - s = (s^3 - s) + 3*(s + s^2) := by grind
  rw [e]; exact Int.dvd_add this (Int.dvd_mul_right 3 _)

name: Fermat4.sq_inj
doc: Squaring is one-to-one on the natural numbers: a² = b² gives a = b.
proof:
Nat.le_antisymm ((Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_left (by decide)).1 (Nat.le_of_eq h))
    ((Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_left (by decide)).1 (Nat.le_of_eq h.symm))

name: Fermat4.sq_mod_four
doc: Every square is 0 or 1 mod 4: 0 for an even number, 1 for an odd one.
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨k, hk | hk⟩ : ∃ k, n = 2*k ∨ n = 2*k+1 := ⟨n/2, by omega⟩
  · left; subst hk
    have : (2*k)^2 = 4*(k*k) := by grind
    rw [this]; omega
  · right; subst hk
    have : (2*k+1)^2 = 4*(k*k+k)+1 := by grind
    rw [this]; omega

name: Fermat4.dvd_sq_self
doc: A number divides its own square.
proof: ⟨n, Nat.pow_two n⟩

name: Fermat4.sq_of_coprime_mul
doc: If a·b is a square and a, b share no factor, then a is itself a square.
proof:
by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos a with ha | ha
  · exact ⟨0, by simp [ha]⟩
  obtain ⟨a', c', hco, ha', hc'⟩ := Nat.exists_coprime a c
  have hg : 0 < Nat.gcd a c := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left c ha
  generalize Nat.gcd a c = g at ha' hc' hg
  subst ha' hc'
  have h1 : a' * b = c'^2 * g := by
    apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hg
    grind
  have h2 : a' ∣ g := Nat.Coprime.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left (hco.pow_right 2) ⟨b, h1.symm⟩
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := h2
  have ha'pos : 0 < a' := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by intro h0; subst h0; simp at ha)
  have hb : b = c'^2 * t := by
    apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left ha'pos
    grind
  have ht : t = 1 := by
    have d1 : t ∣ a' * (a' * t) := ⟨a' * a', by grind⟩
    have d2 : t ∣ b := ⟨c'^2, by rw [hb]; grind⟩
    have := Nat.dvd_gcd d1 d2
    rw [hab.gcd_eq_one] at this
    exact Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_one this
  subst ht
  exact ⟨a', by grind⟩

name: Fermat4.pyth_param
doc: Primitive Pythagorean triples: a² + b² = c² with a odd and gcd(a,b) = 1 gives coprime m, n with a = m² − n² (written a + n² = m²), b = 2mn, c = m² + n².
statement: ∃ m n, a + n^2 = m^2 ∧ c = m^2 + n^2 ∧ b = 2*m*n ∧ Nat.Coprime m n
proof:
by
  have hb : b % 2 = 0 ∧ c % 2 = 1 := by
    rcases sq_mod_four a with ⟨_, h1⟩ | ⟨_, h1⟩ <;> rcases sq_mod_four b with ⟨_, h2⟩ | ⟨_, h2⟩ <;>
      rcases sq_mod_four c with ⟨_, h3⟩ | ⟨_, h3⟩ <;> omega
  have hac : a ≤ c := (Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_left (n := 2) (by decide)).1 (by omega)
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u, c = a + 2*u := ⟨(c-a)/2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w, b = 2*w := ⟨b/2, by omega⟩
  subst hu hw
  have huv : u * (a + u) = w^2 := by
    have : 4 * (u * (a+u)) = 4 * w^2 := by grind
    omega
  have hco : Nat.Coprime u (a+u) := by
    show Nat.gcd u (a+u) = 1
    have d1 : Nat.gcd u (a+u) ∣ a := by
      have := Nat.dvd_sub (Nat.gcd_dvd_right u (a+u)) (Nat.gcd_dvd_left u (a+u))
      rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at this
    have d2 : Nat.gcd u (a+u) ∣ (2*w)^2 := by
      have e : (2*w)^2 = (u * (a+u)) * 4 := by grind
      rw [e]
      exact Nat.dvd_mul_right_of_dvd (Nat.dvd_mul_right_of_dvd (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _) _) _
    have := Nat.dvd_gcd d1 d2
    rw [(hab.pow_right 2).gcd_eq_one] at this
    exact Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_one this
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := sq_of_coprime_mul hco huv
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := sq_of_coprime_mul hco.symm (by rw [Nat.mul_comm]; exact huv)
  refine ⟨m, n, by omega, by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have : w = m * n := sq_inj (by rw [← huv, hm, hn]; grind)
    rw [this]; grind
  · rw [hm, hn] at hco
    exact (hco.symm.coprime_dvd_left (dvd_sq_self m)).coprime_dvd_right (dvd_sq_self n)

name: Fermat4.descent_step
doc: One step of Fermat's descent: a coprime solution of x⁴ + y⁴ = z² (x odd, y ≠ 0) yields a nonzero solution a⁴ + b⁴ = c² with c < z.
proof:
by
  have hx2 : (x^2) % 2 = 1 := by rcases sq_mod_four x with ⟨_, _⟩ | ⟨_, _⟩ <;> omega
  obtain ⟨m, n, h1, h2, h3, hmn⟩ :=
    pyth_param (a := x^2) (b := y^2) (c := z) (by grind) hx2 (Nat.Coprime.pow 2 2 hxy)
  have hxn : Nat.Coprime x n := by
    show Nat.gcd x n = 1
    have d1 : Nat.gcd x n ∣ m^2 := by
      rw [← h1]
      exact Nat.dvd_add (Nat.dvd_trans (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _) (dvd_sq_self x))
        (Nat.dvd_trans (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _) (dvd_sq_self n))
    have := Nat.dvd_gcd (Nat.gcd_dvd_right x n) d1
    rw [(hmn.symm.pow_right 2).gcd_eq_one] at this
    exact Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_one this
  obtain ⟨r, s, h4, h5, h6, hrs⟩ := pyth_param (a := x) (b := n) (c := m) h1 hx hxn
  subst h6
  have hy2 : y^2 = 4 * (m * (r * s)) := by rw [h3]; grind
  have hyev : y % 2 = 0 := by rcases sq_mod_four y with ⟨_, _⟩ | ⟨_, _⟩ <;> omega
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ : ∃ v, y = 2 * v := ⟨y/2, by omega⟩
  have hv : m * (r * s) = v^2 := by
    have : 4 * (m * (r * s)) = 4 * v^2 := by grind
    omega
  have hmrs : Nat.Coprime m (r * s) := hmn.coprime_dvd_right (show r * s ∣ 2 * r * s from ⟨2, by grind⟩)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := sq_of_coprime_mul hmrs hv
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := sq_of_coprime_mul hmrs.symm (by rw [Nat.mul_comm]; exact hv)
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := sq_of_coprime_mul hrs he
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := sq_of_coprime_mul hrs.symm (by rw [Nat.mul_comm]; exact he)
  have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0; subst h0; apply hy
    have : v = 0 := sq_inj (by rw [← hv]; simp)
    omega
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0; subst h0; apply hy
    have : v = 0 := sq_inj (by rw [← hv]; simp)
    omega
  refine ⟨a, b, c, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h0; subst h0; simp at ha; exact hr0 ha
  · intro h0; subst h0; simp at hb; exact hs0 hb
  · have hn : 0 < (2 * r * s)^2 := Nat.pow_pos (by
      have := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hr0; have := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hs0
      exact Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos (by decide) ‹0 < r›) ‹0 < s›)
    have c1 : c ≤ m := by rw [hc, Nat.pow_two]; exact Nat.le_mul_self c
    have c2 : m ≤ m^2 := by rw [Nat.pow_two]; exact Nat.le_mul_self m
    omega
  · rw [← hc, h5, ha, hb]; grind

name: no_x4_y4_z2
doc: No sum of two nonzero fourth powers is a square.
proof:
by
  induction z using Nat.strongRecOn generalizing x y with
  | _ z ih =>
  intro h
  by_cases hco : Nat.Coprime x y
  · have hodd : x % 2 = 1 ∨ y % 2 = 1 := by
      refine Classical.byContradiction fun hc => ?_
      have h2 : 2 ∣ Nat.gcd x y :=
        Nat.dvd_gcd (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero (by omega)) (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero (by omega))
      rw [hco.gcd_eq_one] at h2
      exact absurd (Nat.le_of_dvd (by decide) h2) (by decide)
    rcases hodd with hx1 | hy1
    · obtain ⟨a, b, c, ha, hb, hc, habc⟩ := descent_step hx1 hy hco h
      exact ih c hc a b ha hb habc
    · obtain ⟨a, b, c, ha, hb, hc, habc⟩ := descent_step hy1 hx hco.symm (by rw [← h]; grind)
      exact ih c hc a b ha hb habc
  · obtain ⟨x', y', hco', hx', hy'⟩ := Nat.exists_coprime x y
    have hd1 : Nat.gcd x y ≠ 1 := hco
    have hd0 : Nat.gcd x y ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0; rw [h0] at hx'; exact hx (by simpa using hx')
    generalize Nat.gcd x y = d at hx' hy' hd1 hd0
    subst hx' hy'
    have hdz : d^2 ∣ z :=
      (Nat.pow_dvd_pow_iff (n := 2) (by decide)).1 ⟨x'^4 + y'^4, by rw [← h]; grind⟩
    obtain ⟨z', rfl⟩ := hdz
    have hd4 : 0 < d^4 := Nat.pow_pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hd0)
    have hx'0 : x' ≠ 0 := by intro h0; subst h0; simp at hx
    have hy'0 : y' ≠ 0 := by intro h0; subst h0; simp at hy
    have heq : x'^4 + y'^4 = z'^2 := by
      apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hd4
      grind
    have hz'0 : 0 < z' := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos z' with h0 | h0
      · subst h0
        have : 0 < x'^4 := Nat.pow_pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hx'0)
        simp at heq; omega
      · exact h0
    have hlt : z' < d^2 * z' := by
      have : 4 ≤ d^2 := by
        rw [Nat.pow_two]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul (n₁ := 2) (m₁ := 2) (by omega) (by omega)
      have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right z' this
      omega
    exact ih z' hlt x' y' hx'0 hy'0 heq

name: fermat4
doc: Fermat's Last Theorem for exponent 4.
proof:
by
  intro h
  exact no_x4_y4_z2 x y (z^2) hx hy (by rw [h, ← Nat.pow_mul])

name: fourth_power_ne_mpow_four
doc: Mult-add form of FLT(4): for rationals q ≠ 0 and s, q⁴ is never the mult-add 4th power s^(⊞4) = (1 + s)⁴ − 1.
proof:
by
  intro h
  have hlift : 1 + q^4 = (1 + s)^4 := by rw [h]; exact mpow_lift s 4
  generalize 1 + s = r at hlift
  have den_ne (t : Rat) : (t.den : Rat) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have h1 : ((t.den : Int) : Rat) = ((0 : Int) : Rat) := by
      rw [Rat.intCast_natCast]; exact h0
    have := Rat.intCast_inj.1 h1
    have := t.den_nz
    omega
  have eq_q : q = (q.num : Rat) / (q.den : Rat) := by rw [← Rat.mkRat_eq_div, Rat.mkRat_self]
  have eq_r : r = (r.num : Rat) / (r.den : Rat) := by rw [← Rat.mkRat_eq_div, Rat.mkRat_self]
  have hB := den_ne q
  have hD := den_ne r
   
  have hR : ((q.den : Rat) * r.den)^4 + ((q.num : Rat) * r.den)^4 = ((r.num : Rat) * q.den)^4 := by
    rw [eq_q, eq_r] at hlift
    grind
  have hA0 : q.num ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hq (Rat.num_eq_zero.1 h0)
  generalize q.num = A at hR hA0
  generalize q.den = B at hR hB
  generalize r.num = C at hR
  generalize r.den = D at hR hD
   
  have hI : ((B : Int) * D)^4 + (A * D)^4 = (C * B)^4 := by
    apply Rat.intCast_inj.1
    simp only [Rat.intCast_add, Rat.intCast_mul, Rat.intCast_pow, Rat.intCast_natCast]
    exact hR
   
  have h4 (t : Int) : (t.natAbs : Int)^4 = t^4 := by
    have := Int.natAbs_pow_two t
    calc (t.natAbs : Int)^4 = ((t.natAbs : Int)^2)^2 := by grind
      _ = (t^2)^2 := by rw [this]
      _ = t^4 := by grind
  have hN : (B * D)^4 + (A.natAbs * D)^4 = (C.natAbs * B)^4 := by
    apply Int.ofNat_inj.1
    simp only [Int.natCast_add, Int.natCast_mul, Int.natCast_pow]
    have hA := h4 A
    have hC := h4 C
    grind
  have hB0 : B ≠ 0 := by intro h0; subst h0; exact hB (by simp)
  have hD0 : D ≠ 0 := by intro h0; subst h0; exact hD (by simp)
  have hA' : A.natAbs ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hA0 (Int.natAbs_eq_zero.1 h0)
  exact fermat4 (B * D) (A.natAbs * D) (C.natAbs * B)
    (Nat.mul_ne_zero hB0 hD0) (Nat.mul_ne_zero hA' hD0) hN

name: FermatRoute.flt_of_prime_case
doc: FLT for every n ≥ 3 follows from the prime case p ≥ 5 alone (n = 3 and n = 4 are proved).
proof: flt_reduction_frey fermat4 Fermat3.flt3_nat hp

name: FermatRoute.prime_dvd_of_dvd_pow
doc: A prime dividing x^n divides x (Int).
statement: ∀ {n : Nat}, (q : Int) ∣ x ^ n → (q : Int) ∣ x
proof:
| 0, h => by
      exfalso
      rw [Int.pow_zero, Int.ofNat_dvd_left] at h
      have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by decide) h
      have := hq.1; simp at *; omega
  | n + 1, h => by
      rw [Int.pow_succ] at h
      rcases euclid_int hq h with h1 | h1
      · exact prime_dvd_of_dvd_pow hq h1
      · exact h1

name: FermatRoute.gcd_one_of_no_prime
doc: Two nonzero Ints with no common prime factor are coprime.
proof:
by
  have hpos : 0 < Int.gcd a c := Int.gcd_pos_of_ne_zero_left c ha
  by_cases h1 : Int.gcd a c = 1
  · exact h1
  · obtain ⟨q, hq, hqd⟩ := MultAdd.Cube.exists_prime_factor (Int.gcd a c) (by omega)
    exfalso
    apply H q hq
    · exact Int.ofNat_dvd_left.mpr (Nat.dvd_trans hqd (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _))
    · exact Int.ofNat_dvd_left.mpr (Nat.dvd_trans hqd (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _))

name: FermatRoute.dvd_self_pow
doc: x divides x^p for p ≥ 1.
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, p = m + 1 := ⟨p - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [Int.pow_succ]; exact Int.dvd_mul_left _ _

name: FermatRoute.cop_left
doc: In a solution a^p + b^p = c^p with gcd(a, b) = 1, also gcd(a, c) = 1.
proof:
by
  apply gcd_one_of_no_prime ha
  intro q hq hqa hqc
  have hb : (q : Int) ∣ b ^ p := by
    have : b ^ p = c ^ p - a ^ p := by omega
    rw [this]
    exact Int.dvd_sub (Int.dvd_trans hqc (dvd_self_pow c hp))
      (Int.dvd_trans hqa (dvd_self_pow a hp))
  have hqb := prime_dvd_of_dvd_pow hq hb
  have : q ∣ Int.gcd a b := Nat.dvd_gcd (Int.ofNat_dvd_left.mp hqa) (Int.ofNat_dvd_left.mp hqb)
  rw [hcop] at this
  have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by decide) this
  have := hq.1; omega

name: FermatRoute.gcd_natAbs_congr
doc: Int.gcd only sees absolute values.
statement: Int.gcd a' b' = Int.gcd a b
proof:
by
  show Nat.gcd a'.natAbs b'.natAbs = Nat.gcd a.natAbs b.natAbs
  rw [ha, hb]

name: FermatRoute.normalize_core'
doc: 2d, with coprimality kept: re-signing keeps |a'| = |o1|, |b'| = |e|.
statement: ∃ a' b' c' : Int, a' ^ p + b' ^ p = c' ^ p ∧ a' % 4 = 3 ∧ b' % 2 = 0 ∧ (a' * b' * c').natAbs = (o1 * e * o2).natAbs ∧ a'.natAbs = o1.natAbs ∧ b'.natAbs = e.natAbs
proof:
by
  rcases (show o1 % 4 = 3 ∨ o1 % 4 = 1 by omega) with h4 | h4
  · refine ⟨o1, e, -o2, ?_, h4, he, ?_, rfl, rfl⟩
    · rw [neg_pow_of_odd hp]; omega
    · simp [Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_neg]
  · refine ⟨-o1, -e, o2, ?_, by omega, by omega, ?_, Int.natAbs_neg o1, Int.natAbs_neg e⟩
    · rw [neg_pow_of_odd hp, neg_pow_of_odd hp]; omega
    · simp [Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_neg]

name: FermatRoute.frey_normalize_cop
doc: Frey normalization keeping gcd(a', b') = 1: the input the Frey curve needs.
proof:
by
  have hp1 : 1 ≤ p := by omega
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := fun e => habc (by rw [e]; simp)
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := fun e => habc (by rw [e]; simp)
  have hac : Int.gcd a c = 1 := cop_left ha0 hcop h hp1
  have hbc : Int.gcd b c = 1 :=
    cop_left hb0 (by rw [Int.gcd_comm]; exact hcop) (by omega) hp1
  have ha := int_pow_emod_two a hp1
  have hb := int_pow_emod_two b hp1
  have hc := int_pow_emod_two c hp1
  have hnot : ¬ (a % 2 = 0 ∧ b % 2 = 0) := by
    rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have d1 : 2 ∣ a.natAbs := Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.mpr (Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero h1)
    have d2 : 2 ∣ b.natAbs := Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.mpr (Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero h2)
    have : 2 ∣ Int.gcd a b := Nat.dvd_gcd d1 d2
    rw [hcop] at this; omega
  have hm : (a ^ p + b ^ p) % 2 = c ^ p % 2 := by rw [h]
  rw [Int.add_emod, ha, hb, hc] at hm
  have hnc := neg_pow_of_odd hp c
  suffices H : ∃ a' b' c' : Int, a' ^ p + b' ^ p = c' ^ p ∧ a' % 4 = 3 ∧ b' % 2 = 0
      ∧ (a' * b' * c').natAbs = (a * b * c).natAbs ∧ Int.gcd a' b' = 1 by
    obtain ⟨a', b', c', h1, h2, h3, h4, hg⟩ := H
    refine ⟨a', b', c', h1, h2, h3, hg, ?_, two_pow_dvd h5 h3⟩
    intro h0
    rw [h0] at h4
    exact habc (Int.natAbs_eq_zero.mp h4.symm)
  rcases (show (a % 2 = 0 ∧ b % 2 = 1 ∧ c % 2 = 1) ∨ (a % 2 = 1 ∧ b % 2 = 0)
      ∨ (a % 2 = 1 ∧ b % 2 = 1 ∧ c % 2 = 0) by omega) with ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
  · obtain ⟨a', b', c', e1, e2, e3, e4, e5, e6⟩ :=
      normalize_core' hp h2 h1 (o2 := -c) (by rw [hnc]; omega)
    refine ⟨a', b', c', e1, e2, e3, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [e4]; simp [Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_neg]; grind
    · rw [gcd_natAbs_congr e5 e6, Int.gcd_comm]; exact hcop
  · obtain ⟨a', b', c', e1, e2, e3, e4, e5, e6⟩ :=
      normalize_core' hp h1 h2 (o2 := -c) (by rw [hnc]; omega)
    refine ⟨a', b', c', e1, e2, e3, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [e4]; simp [Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_neg]
    · rw [gcd_natAbs_congr e5 e6]; exact hcop
  · obtain ⟨a', b', c', e1, e2, e3, e4, e5, e6⟩ :=
      normalize_core' hp h1 (show (-c) % 2 = 0 by omega) (o2 := b) (by rw [hnc]; omega)
    refine ⟨a', b', c', e1, e2, e3, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [e4]; simp [Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_neg]; grind
    · rw [gcd_natAbs_congr e5 (e6.trans (Int.natAbs_neg c))]; exact hac

name: FermatRoute.flt_of_no_frey_curve
doc: Fermat's Last Theorem for every n ≥ 3, given only `NoFreyCurve`.
proof:
by
  apply flt_of_prime_case
  intro p hp h5
  apply flt_of_coprime (by omega)
  intro x y z hx hy hcop hxyz
  have hodd : p % 2 = 1 := prime_ne_two_odd hp (by omega)
  have hI : (x : Int) ^ p + (y : Int) ^ p = (z : Int) ^ p := by exact_mod_cast hxyz
  have hg : Int.gcd (x : Int) (y : Int) = 1 := by
    rw [Int.gcd_natCast_natCast]; exact hcop
  have hz : (z : Int) ≠ 0 := by
    intro e
    have hz0 : z = 0 := by exact_mod_cast e
    subst hz0
    rw [Nat.zero_pow (by omega)] at hxyz
    have : x ^ p = 0 := by omega
    exact hx (Nat.pow_eq_zero.mp this).1
  have habc : (x : Int) * (y : Int) * (z : Int) ≠ 0 := by
    have hx' : (x : Int) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hx
    have hy' : (y : Int) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hy
    exact Int.mul_ne_zero (Int.mul_ne_zero hx' hy') hz
  obtain ⟨a', b', c', he, ha4, hb2, hg', hne, h32⟩ := frey_normalize_cop hodd h5 hg habc hI
  exact H p hp h5 a' b' c' hg' hne ha4 hb2 h32 he

name: FreyPieces.flt_of_dvd
doc: 1a. FLT for d gives FLT for every multiple n of d (x^n = (x^(n/d))^d).
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hdn
  intro x y z hx hy h
  apply hd (x ^ k) (y ^ k) (z ^ k) ((Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp (Nat.pow_pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hx)))) ((Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp (Nat.pow_pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hy))))
  rw [← Nat.pow_mul, ← Nat.pow_mul, ← Nat.pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm k d]
  exact h

name: FreyPieces.prime_ne_two_odd
doc: A prime other than 2 is odd.
proof:
by
  rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one p with h | h
  · exfalso
    rcases hp.2 2 (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h) with h' | h'
    · omega
    · exact h2 h'.symm
  · exact h

name: FreyPieces.four_or_odd_prime
doc: 1b. Every n ≥ 3 is divisible by 4 or by an odd prime.
statement: 4 ∣ n ∨ ∃ p, IsPrime p ∧ p ≠ 2 ∧ p ∣ n
proof:
by
  have oddcase : ∀ m, 2 ≤ m → m % 2 = 1 → ∃ p, IsPrime p ∧ p ≠ 2 ∧ p ∣ m := by
    intro m hm hodd
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpm⟩ := exists_prime_factor m hm
    refine ⟨p, hp, ?_, hpm⟩
    rintro rfl
    have := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd hpm
    omega
  rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one n with h | h
  · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h
    rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one m with h' | h'
    · left
      obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h'
      exact ⟨k, by omega⟩
    · right
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hp2, hpm⟩ := oddcase m (by omega) h'
      exact ⟨p, hp, hp2, Nat.dvd_trans hpm (Nat.dvd_mul_left m 2)⟩
  · right; exact oddcase n (by omega) h

lean_shape.text: 4 ∣ n ∨ ∃ p, MultAdd.Cube.IsPrime p ∧ p ≠ 2 ∧ p ∣ n

name: FreyPieces.flt_reduction
doc: 1c. FLT 4 and FLT for every odd prime give FLT for every n ≥ 3.
proof:
by
  intro n hn
  rcases four_or_odd_prime n hn with h | ⟨p, hpp, hp2, hpn⟩
  · exact flt_of_dvd h h4
  · exact flt_of_dvd hpn (hp p hpp hp2)

name: FreyPieces.flt_reduction_frey
doc: 1d. FLT 4, FLT 3 and FLT for every prime p ≥ 5 (the Frey range) give FLT for every n ≥ 3.
proof:
by
  apply flt_reduction h4
  intro p hpp hp2
  have h1 := hpp.1
  rcases (show p = 3 ∨ p = 4 ∨ 5 ≤ p by omega) with h | h | h
  · subst h; exact h3
  · subst h
    rcases hpp.2 2 ⟨2, rfl⟩ with h' | h' <;> omega
  · exact hp p hpp h

name: FreyPieces.euclid
doc: 2a. Euclid's lemma on Nat: a prime dividing a product divides a factor.
proof:
by
  rcases hp.2 _ (Nat.gcd_dvd_left p a) with h1 | h1
  · right; exact Nat.Coprime.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left h1 h
  · left; rw [← h1]; exact Nat.gcd_dvd_right p a

name: FreyPieces.euclid_int
doc: 2a. Euclid's lemma on Int (through natAbs).
proof:
by
  rw [← Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs, Int.natAbs_mul] at h
  simp only [Int.natAbs_natCast] at h
  rcases euclid hp h with h' | h'
  · left; rw [← Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs]; simpa using h'
  · right; rw [← Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs]; simpa using h'

name: FreyPieces.odd_prime_coprime_two
doc: An odd prime is coprime to 2 (so to every power of 2).
proof:
by
  have := prime_ne_two_odd hq h2
  rcases hq.2 _ (Nat.gcd_dvd_left q 2) with h | h
  · exact h
  · exfalso
    have hd : q ∣ 2 := h ▸ Nat.gcd_dvd_right q 2
    have h3 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hd
    have h4 := hq.1
    omega

name: FreyPieces.coprime_reduction
doc: 2b. A solution with x, y ≠ 0 shrinks (divide by gcd x y) to one with gcd x' y' = 1.
statement: ∃ x' y' z', x' ≠ 0 ∧ y' ≠ 0 ∧ Nat.gcd x' y' = 1 ∧ x' ^ n + y' ^ n = z' ^ n ∧ x' ∣ x ∧ y' ∣ y
proof:
by
  have hg : 0 < Nat.gcd x y := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left y (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hx)
  generalize hgd : Nat.gcd x y = g at hg
  obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ : g ∣ x := hgd ▸ Nat.gcd_dvd_left x y
  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ : g ∣ y := hgd ▸ Nat.gcd_dvd_right x y
  have hcop : Nat.gcd x' y' = 1 := by
    have := Nat.gcd_mul_left g x' y'
    rw [← hx', ← hy', hgd] at this
    have h2 : g * 1 = g * Nat.gcd x' y' := by rw [Nat.mul_one]; exact this
    exact (Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hg h2).symm
  have hsum : z ^ n = g ^ n * (x' ^ n + y' ^ n) := by
    rw [← h, hx', hy', Nat.mul_pow, Nat.mul_pow, Nat.mul_add]
  have hgz : g ∣ z := by
    rw [← Nat.pow_dvd_pow_iff (show n ≠ 0 by omega), hsum]
    exact Nat.dvd_mul_right _ _
  obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := hgz
  refine ⟨x', y', z', ?_, ?_, hcop, ?_, ⟨g, by rw [hx', Nat.mul_comm]⟩, ⟨g, by rw [hy', Nat.mul_comm]⟩⟩
  · rintro rfl; simp at hx'; exact hx hx'
  · rintro rfl; simp at hy'; exact hy hy'
  · rw [hz', Nat.mul_pow] at hsum
    exact (Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left ((Nat.pow_pos hg)) hsum).symm

name: FreyPieces.flt_of_coprime
doc: 2b. So FLT n holds once coprime solutions are ruled out.
proof:
by
  intro x y z hx hy hxyz
  obtain ⟨x', y', z', hx', hy', hc, he, -, -⟩ := coprime_reduction hn hx hy hxyz
  exact h x' y' z' hx' hy' hc he

name: FreyPieces.pow_mod_two
doc: x^n has the parity of x for n ≥ 1.
proof:
by
  rw [Nat.pow_mod]
  rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one x with h | h <;> rw [h]
  · rw [Nat.zero_pow (by omega)]
  · rw [Nat.one_pow]

name: FreyPieces.coprime_parity
doc: 2c. In a coprime solution exactly one of x, y, z is even.
proof:
by
  have hx := pow_mod_two (x := x) hn
  have hy := pow_mod_two (x := y) hn
  have hz := pow_mod_two (x := z) hn
  have hm : (x ^ n + y ^ n) % 2 = z ^ n % 2 := by rw [h]
  rw [Nat.add_mod, hx, hy, hz] at hm
  have hnot : ¬ (x % 2 = 0 ∧ y % 2 = 0) := by
    rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have : 2 ∣ Nat.gcd x y := Nat.dvd_gcd (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h1) (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h2)
    rw [hc] at this; omega
  omega

name: FreyPieces.neg_pow_odd
proof:
by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [Int.pow_succ]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [show 2 * (k + 1) + 1 = (2 * k + 1) + 1 + 1 by omega, Int.pow_succ, Int.pow_succ, ih,
      Int.pow_succ x (2 * k + 1 + 1), Int.pow_succ x (2 * k + 1)]
    grind

name: FreyPieces.neg_pow_of_odd
doc: (−x)^p = −x^p for odd p.
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, p = 2 * k + 1 := ⟨p / 2, by omega⟩
  exact neg_pow_odd x k

name: FreyPieces.int_pow_emod_two
doc: Over Int, x^n % 2 = x % 2 for n ≥ 1.
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with h0 | h0
    · subst h0; simp [Int.pow_succ]
    · rw [Int.pow_succ, Int.mul_emod, ih h0]
      rcases (show x % 2 = 0 ∨ x % 2 = 1 by omega) with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> decide

name: FreyPieces.normalize_core
doc: From o1^p + e^p + o2^p = 0 with o1 odd, e even: re-sign to a' ≡ 3 mod 4, b' even.
statement: ∃ a' b' c' : Int, a' ^ p + b' ^ p = c' ^ p ∧ a' % 4 = 3 ∧ b' % 2 = 0 ∧ (a' * b' * c').natAbs = (o1 * e * o2).natAbs
proof:
by
  rcases (show o1 % 4 = 3 ∨ o1 % 4 = 1 by omega) with h4 | h4
  · refine ⟨o1, e, -o2, ?_, h4, he, ?_⟩
    · rw [neg_pow_of_odd hp]; omega
    · simp [Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_neg]
  · refine ⟨-o1, -e, o2, ?_, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
    · rw [neg_pow_of_odd hp, neg_pow_of_odd hp]; omega
    · simp [Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_neg]

name: FreyPieces.two_pow_dvd
doc: b even and p ≥ 5 give 32 ∣ b^p.
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, b = 2 * k := ⟨b / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, p = 5 + m := ⟨p - 5, by omega⟩
  rw [mul_pow', pow_add']
  exact ⟨2 ^ m * k ^ (5 + m), by rw [show (2:Int) ^ 5 = 32 by decide]; grind⟩

name: FreyPieces.frey_normalize
doc: 2d. Frey normalization: a coprime Int solution for odd p ≥ 5 becomes one with a' ≡ 3 mod 4, b' even, 32 ∣ b'^p, same |abc|.
statement: ∃ a' b' c' : Int, a' ^ p + b' ^ p = c' ^ p ∧ a' % 4 = 3 ∧ b' % 2 = 0 ∧ (a' * b' * c').natAbs = (a * b * c).natAbs ∧ a' * b' * c' ≠ 0 ∧ (32 : Int) ∣ b' ^ p
proof:
by
  have hp1 : 1 ≤ p := by omega
  have ha := int_pow_emod_two a hp1
  have hb := int_pow_emod_two b hp1
  have hc := int_pow_emod_two c hp1
  have hnot : ¬ (a % 2 = 0 ∧ b % 2 = 0) := by
    rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have d1 : 2 ∣ a.natAbs := Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.mpr (Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero h1)
    have d2 : 2 ∣ b.natAbs := Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.mpr (Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero h2)
    have : 2 ∣ Int.gcd a b := Nat.dvd_gcd d1 d2
    rw [hcop] at this; omega
  have hm : (a ^ p + b ^ p) % 2 = c ^ p % 2 := by rw [h]
  rw [Int.add_emod, ha, hb, hc] at hm
  have hnc := neg_pow_of_odd hp c
  suffices H : ∃ a' b' c' : Int, a' ^ p + b' ^ p = c' ^ p ∧ a' % 4 = 3 ∧ b' % 2 = 0
      ∧ (a' * b' * c').natAbs = (a * b * c).natAbs by
    obtain ⟨a', b', c', h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := H
    refine ⟨a', b', c', h1, h2, h3, h4, ?_, two_pow_dvd h5 h3⟩
    intro h0
    rw [h0] at h4
    exact habc (Int.natAbs_eq_zero.mp h4.symm)
  rcases (show (a % 2 = 0 ∧ b % 2 = 1 ∧ c % 2 = 1) ∨ (a % 2 = 1 ∧ b % 2 = 0)
      ∨ (a % 2 = 1 ∧ b % 2 = 1 ∧ c % 2 = 0) by omega) with ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
  · obtain ⟨a', b', c', e1, e2, e3, e4⟩ := normalize_core hp h2 h1 (o2 := -c) (by rw [hnc]; omega)
    refine ⟨a', b', c', e1, e2, e3, ?_⟩
    rw [e4]; simp [Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_neg]; grind
  · obtain ⟨a', b', c', e1, e2, e3, e4⟩ := normalize_core hp h1 h2 (o2 := -c) (by rw [hnc]; omega)
    refine ⟨a', b', c', e1, e2, e3, ?_⟩
    rw [e4]; simp [Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_neg]
  · obtain ⟨a', b', c', e1, e2, e3, e4⟩ :=
      normalize_core hp h1 (show (-c) % 2 = 0 by omega) (o2 := b) (by rw [hnc]; omega)
    refine ⟨a', b', c', e1, e2, e3, ?_⟩
    rw [e4]; simp [Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_neg]; grind

name: FreyPieces.frey_two_torsion
doc: 3a. The 2-torsion points (0,0), (A,0), (−B,0) lie on E.
statement: (0 : Int) * 0 = freyRHS A B 0 ∧ (0 : Int) * 0 = freyRHS A B A ∧ (0 : Int) * 0 = freyRHS A B (-B)
proof:
by
  unfold freyRHS; refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> grind

name: FreyPieces.frey_disc_roots
doc: 3b. 16·(product of root differences)² = 16(ABC)² when A + B = C.
proof:
by
  subst hC; grind

name: FreyPieces.frey_change_of_vars
doc: 3c. The identity behind x = 4X, y = 8Y + 4X.
proof: by grind

name: FreyPieces.frey_minimal_divisibility
doc: 3c. A ≡ 3 mod 4 and 16 ∣ B give 4 ∣ B − A − 1 and 16 ∣ AB.
proof:
by
  exact ⟨by omega, Int.dvd_trans hB (Int.dvd_mul_left A B)⟩

name: FreyPieces.frey_minimal_model
doc: 3c. With these integers, (4X, 8Y + 4X) is on E exactly when Y² + XY = X³ + a2X² + a4X.
statement: 4 * a2of A B = B - A - 1 ∧ 16 * a4of A B = -(A * B) ∧ ∀ X Y : Int, (8 * Y + 4 * X) ^ 2 = freyRHS A B (4 * X) ↔ Y ^ 2 + X * Y = X ^ 3 + a2of A B * X ^ 2 + a4of A B * X
proof:
by
  have h1 : 4 * a2of A B = B - A - 1 := by unfold a2of; omega
  have h2 : 16 * a4of A B = -(A * B) := by
    unfold a4of
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hB
    have : A * B = 16 * (A * k) := by rw [hk]; grind
    rw [this]; generalize A * k = m; omega
  refine ⟨h1, h2, fun X Y => ?_⟩
  have key := frey_change_of_vars A B X Y
  unfold freyRHS
  generalize a2of A B = a2 at h1
  generalize a4of A B = a4 at h2
  constructor
  · intro h; grind
  · intro h; grind

name: FreyPieces.frey_c4
doc: 3d. c4 of the Frey model is A² + AB + B².
statement: (freyModel a2 a4).c4 = A ^ 2 + A * B + B ^ 2
proof:
by
  simp only [Weier.c4, Weier.b2, Weier.b4, freyModel]
  grind

name: FreyPieces.frey_disc
doc: 3d. 256·Δ of the Frey model is (ABC)².
proof:
by
  subst hC
  simp only [Weier.disc, Weier.b2, Weier.b4, Weier.b6, Weier.b8, freyModel]
  have hb2 : 1 ^ 2 + 4 * a2 = B - A := by grind
  rw [hb2]
  grind

name: FreyPieces.prime_dvd_gcd_false
doc: A prime cannot divide two coprime integers.
proof:
by
  have d1 : q ∣ A.natAbs := by simpa using Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.mpr hA
  have d2 : q ∣ B.natAbs := by simpa using Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.mpr hB
  have : q ∣ Int.gcd A B := Nat.dvd_gcd d1 d2
  rw [hcop] at this
  have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) this
  have := hq.1
  omega

name: FreyPieces.frey_c4_not_dvd
doc: 3e. If gcd(A, B) = 1, a prime dividing ABC does not divide A² + AB + B².
proof:
by
  intro hc
  rcases euclid_int hq hd with hab | hC'
  · rcases euclid_int hq hab with hA | hB
    · have : (q : Int) ∣ B * B := by
        have e : B * B = (A ^ 2 + A * B + B ^ 2) - A * (A + B) := by grind
        rw [e]; exact Int.dvd_sub hc (Int.dvd_trans hA (Int.dvd_mul_right A _))
      rcases euclid_int hq this with h | h <;> exact prime_dvd_gcd_false hq hcop hA h
    · have : (q : Int) ∣ A * A := by
        have e : A * A = (A ^ 2 + A * B + B ^ 2) - B * (A + B) := by grind
        rw [e]; exact Int.dvd_sub hc (Int.dvd_trans hB (Int.dvd_mul_right B _))
      rcases euclid_int hq this with h | h <;> exact prime_dvd_gcd_false hq hcop h hB
  · have : (q : Int) ∣ A * A := by
      have e : A * A = (A ^ 2 + A * B + B ^ 2) - B * C := by subst hC; grind
      rw [e]; exact Int.dvd_sub hc (Int.dvd_trans hC' (Int.dvd_mul_left B C))
    rcases euclid_int hq this with h | h <;>
    · have hB : (q : Int) ∣ B := by
        have e : B = C - A := by omega
        rw [e]; exact Int.dvd_sub hC' h
      exact prime_dvd_gcd_false hq hcop h hB

name: FreyPieces.frey_semistable
doc: 3e. Semistability: a prime dividing Δ never divides c4 (node, not cusp).
proof:
by
  rw [frey_c4 h2 h4]
  apply frey_c4_not_dvd hC hcop hq
  have h256 : (q : Int) ∣ (A * B * C) * (A * B * C) := by
    rw [show (A * B * C) * (A * B * C) = (A * B * C) ^ 2 by grind, ← frey_disc hC h2 h4]
    exact Int.dvd_trans hd (Int.dvd_mul_left 256 _)
  rcases euclid_int hq h256 with h | h <;> exact h

name: FreyPieces.frey_at_two
doc: 3e. At 2: A odd and 32 ∣ B make c4 odd and 4 ∣ Δ, so 2 is a bad prime with a node.
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hB
  constructor
  · rw [frey_c4 h2 h4]
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, A = 2 * k + 1 := ⟨A / 2, by omega⟩
    have : (2 * k + 1) ^ 2 + (2 * k + 1) * (32 * m) + (32 * m) ^ 2
        = 2 * (2 * k * k + 2 * k + 32 * k * m + 16 * m + 512 * m * m) + 1 := by grind
    rw [this]; omega
  · have hD := frey_disc hC h2 h4
    have : (A * (32 * m) * C) ^ 2 = 1024 * (A * m * C) ^ 2 := by grind
    rw [this] at hD
    exact ⟨(A * m * C) ^ 2, by omega⟩

name: FreyPieces.frey_a4_mod_q
doc: 3f. For an odd prime q dividing A, q divides a4.
proof:
by
  have h16 : (q : Int) ∣ 16 * a4 := by
    rw [h4]; exact Int.dvd_neg.mpr (Int.dvd_trans hA (Int.dvd_mul_right A B))
  rw [← Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs, Int.natAbs_mul] at h16
  simp only [Int.natAbs_natCast] at h16
  have hc : Nat.Coprime q 16 := Nat.Coprime.pow_right 4 (odd_prime_coprime_two hq h2)
  have := Nat.Coprime.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hc h16
  rw [← Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs]; simpa using this

name: FreyPieces.frey_reduces_to_node
doc: 3f. Then mod q the model is the node family Y² + 1·XY = X³ + a2X².
statement: MEq q (Y * Y + X * Y - (X * X * X + a2 * X * X + a4 * X)) (Y * Y + 1 * X * Y - (X * X * X + a2 * X * X))
proof:
by
  unfold MEq
  rw [show Y * Y + X * Y - (X * X * X + a2 * X * X + a4 * X) - (Y * Y + 1 * X * Y - (X * X * X + a2 * X * X))
      = a4 * (-X) by grind]
  exact Int.dvd_trans h (Int.dvd_mul_right a4 _)

lean_shape.text: MultAdd.Cube.MEq q (Y * Y + X * Y - (X * X * X + a2 * X * X + a4 * X)) (Y * Y + 1 * X * Y - (X * X * X + a2 * X * X))

name: FreyPieces.node_chord_identity
doc: 3f. (m2 − m1)·det = Vandermonde · (∏(tᵢ − m1) − ∏(tᵢ − m2)).
statement: (m2 - m1) * chordDet (nodeX m1 m2 t1) (t1 * nodeX m1 m2 t1) (nodeX m1 m2 t2) (t2 * nodeX m1 m2 t2) (nodeX m1 m2 t3) (t3 * nodeX m1 m2 t3) = (t1 - t2) * (t2 - t3) * (t3 - t1) * ((t1 - m1) * (t2 - m1) * (t3 - m1) - (t1 - m2) * (t2 - m2) * (t3 - m2))
proof:
by
  unfold chordDet nodeX; grind

FreyPieces.chordDet (FreyPieces.nodeX m1 m2 t1) (t1 * FreyPieces.nodeX m1 m2 t1) (FreyPieces.nodeX m1 m2 t2)
  (t2 * FreyPieces.nodeX m1 m2 t2) (FreyPieces.nodeX m1 m2 t3) (t3 * FreyPieces.nodeX m1 m2 t3)

name: FreyPieces.node_point
doc: 3f. The point (x, t·x), x = nodeX, lies on y² + a1xy = x³ + a2x² with a1 = −(m1+m2), a2 = −m1m2 (library node_param).
proof:
nodeX m1 m2 t
    (t * x) * (t * x) + (-(m1 + m2)) * x * (t * x) = x * x * x + (-(m1 * m2)) * x * x := by
  intro x
  have h := EllipticLead.node_param (-(m1 + m2)) (-(m1 * m2)) t
  have e : x = t * t + (-(m1 + m2)) * t - (-(m1 * m2)) := by
    simp only [x, nodeX]; rw [EllipticLead.slopes_factor]
  rw [e]; exact h

lean_shape.text:
have x := FreyPieces.nodeX m1 m2 t;
t * x * (t * x) + -(m1 + m2) * x * (t * x) = x * x * x + -(m1 * m2) * x * x

name: FreyPieces.rat_mul_ne_zero
doc: Nonzero times nonzero is nonzero in Rat.
proof:
by
  intro h; rcases Rat.mul_eq_zero.mp h with h | h <;> contradiction

name: FreyPieces.one_add_div_mul
doc: (1 + d/b)·b = b + d for b ≠ 0.
proof:
by
  rw [Rat.add_mul, Rat.div_mul_cancel h, Rat.one_mul]

name: FreyPieces.node_chord_multAdd
doc: 3f. Link: three points of the node are collinear exactly when s1 ⊞ s2 ⊞ s3 = 0, sᵢ = (m2 − m1)/(tᵢ − m2).
statement: chordDet (nodeX m1 m2 t1) (t1 * nodeX m1 m2 t1) (nodeX m1 m2 t2) (t2 * nodeX m1 m2 t2) (nodeX m1 m2 t3) (t3 * nodeX m1 m2 t3) = 0 ↔ multAdd (multAdd ((m2 - m1) / (t1 - m2)) ((m2 - m1) / (t2 - m2))) ((m2 - m1) / (t3 - m2)) = 0
proof:
by
  have key := node_chord_identity m1 m2 t1 t2 t3
  have sub_ne : ∀ u v : Rat, u ≠ v → u - v ≠ 0 := fun u v h e => h (by grind)
  have e1 := sub_ne _ _ h1
  have e2 := sub_ne _ _ h2
  have e3 := sub_ne _ _ h3
  have hlift : (1 + multAdd (multAdd ((m2 - m1) / (t1 - m2)) ((m2 - m1) / (t2 - m2))) ((m2 - m1) / (t3 - m2)))
      * ((t1 - m2) * (t2 - m2) * (t3 - m2)) = (t1 - m1) * (t2 - m1) * (t3 - m1) := by
    rw [multAdd_lift, multAdd_lift]
    have f1 := one_add_div_mul (d := m2 - m1) e1
    have f2 := one_add_div_mul (d := m2 - m1) e2
    have f3 := one_add_div_mul (d := m2 - m1) e3
    generalize 1 + (m2 - m1) / (t1 - m2) = u1 at f1 ⊢
    generalize 1 + (m2 - m1) / (t2 - m2) = u2 at f2 ⊢
    generalize 1 + (m2 - m1) / (t3 - m2) = u3 at f3 ⊢
    grind
  have hV : (t1 - t2) * (t2 - t3) * (t3 - t1) ≠ 0 :=
    rat_mul_ne_zero (rat_mul_ne_zero (sub_ne _ _ h12) (sub_ne _ _ h23)) (sub_ne _ _ h31)
  have hB : (t1 - m2) * (t2 - m2) * (t3 - m2) ≠ 0 := rat_mul_ne_zero (rat_mul_ne_zero e1 e2) e3
  have hd : m2 - m1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne _ _ (fun h => hm h.symm)
  generalize chordDet (nodeX m1 m2 t1) (t1 * nodeX m1 m2 t1) (nodeX m1 m2 t2)
        (t2 * nodeX m1 m2 t2) (nodeX m1 m2 t3) (t3 * nodeX m1 m2 t3) = D at key ⊢
  generalize multAdd (multAdd ((m2 - m1) / (t1 - m2)) ((m2 - m1) / (t2 - m2))) ((m2 - m1) / (t3 - m2)) = S at hlift ⊢
  generalize (t1 - t2) * (t2 - t3) * (t3 - t1) = V at key hV
  generalize (t1 - m2) * (t2 - m2) * (t3 - m2) = Pb at key hlift hB
  generalize (t1 - m1) * (t2 - m1) * (t3 - m1) = Pa at key hlift
  constructor
  · intro hD
    rw [hD] at key
    have : Pa - Pb = 0 := by
      rcases Rat.mul_eq_zero.mp (show V * (Pa - Pb) = 0 by grind) with h | h
      · exact absurd h hV
      · exact h
    have : S * Pb = 0 := by grind
    rcases Rat.mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd h hB
  · intro hS
    rw [hS] at hlift
    have : (m2 - m1) * D = 0 := by grind
    rcases Rat.mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
    · exact absurd h hd
    · exact h
